scripts.title: Auto Play
scripts.author: tylenol
scripts.summary: Auto Player for Symphony Ochestra.
scripts.code:
if _G.__SYMPHONY_AP then
    local old = _G.__SYMPHONY_AP
    old.alive = false
    pcall(function() old.conn:Disconnect() end)
    pcall(function() old.win:Destroy() end)
    _G.__SYMPHONY_AP = nil
end

local Players = game:GetService('Players')
local RunService = game:GetService('RunService')
local LP = Players.LocalPlayer

local state = { alive = true, enabled = false, lastNote = {} }
_G.__SYMPHONY_AP = state

local function upsOf(f)
    local ok, ups = pcall(getupvalues, f)
    if not ok or type(ups) ~= 'table' then return nil end
    return ups
end

local engine, resolveErr = nil, nil
do
    local function isKeymap(t)
        for k in pairs(t) do
            return typeof(k) == 'EnumItem'
        end
        return false
    end

    local function validateLaneDown(f)
        if type(f) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        local ld = upsOf(f)
        if not ld or #ld < 13 then return nil end
        local Config = ld[8]
        if type(Config) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'PerfectWindow')) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(rawget(Config, 'DefaultLaneKeys')) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[4]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[7]) ~= 'number' then return nil end
        if type(ld[10]) ~= 'table' or type(ld[2]) ~= 'table' then return nil end
        if type(ld[11]) ~= 'number' or type(ld[12]) ~= 'function' then return nil end
        return { laneDown = f, Config = Config, held = ld[2] }
    end

    local ok, res = pcall(function()
        local conns = getconnections(LP:GetAttributeChangedSignal('OrchestraPadKeys'))
        local found = nil
        for _, c in ipairs(conns) do
            if found then break end
            local u = upsOf(c.Function)
            if u and type(u[1]) == 'function' and type(u[2]) == 'boolean' and type(u[3]) == 'function' then
                local bl = upsOf(u[3])
                if bl then
                    for i = 1, #bl do
                        if found then break end
                        if type(bl[i]) == 'function' then
                            local ola = upsOf(bl[i])
                            if ola then
                                for j = 1, #ola do
                                    if found then break end
                                    if type(ola[j]) == 'function' then
                                        local hit = validateLaneDown(ola[j])
                                        if hit then
                                            local keymap
                                            for k = 1, #ola do
                                                if type(ola[k]) == 'table' and isKeymap(ola[k]) then
                                                    keymap = ola[k]
                                                end
                                            end
                                            if keymap then
                                                hit.onLaneAction = bl[i]
                                                hit.keymap = keymap
                                                found = hit
                                            end
                                        end
                                    end
                                end
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
        assert(found, 'RhythmClient lane engine not found')
        return found
    end)
    if ok then engine = res else resolveErr = tostring(res) end
end
state.engine = engine

local function pressLane(lane)
    local Config = engine.Config
    local keymap = engine.keymap
    local key = Config.LaneKeys and Config.LaneKeys[lane]
    if not (key and keymap[key] == lane) then
        key = nil
        for k, v in pairs(keymap) do
            if v == lane then key = k break end
        end
    end
    if not key then return false end
    return pcall(engine.onLaneAction, nil, Enum.UserInputState.Begin, { KeyCode = key })
end

if engine then
    state.conn = RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
        if not state.alive then return end
        if not state.enabled then return end

        local ld = upsOf(engine.laneDown)
        if not ld then return end
        local clockOff, songStart, notes = ld[4], ld[7], ld[10]
        if type(clockOff) ~= 'number' or type(songStart) ~= 'number' or type(notes) ~= 'table' then return end
        local n = #notes
        if n == 0 then return end

        local Config = engine.Config
        local audioOff = (Config.AudioOffset or 0) + (LP:GetAttribute('OrchestraAudioOffset') or 0) / 1000
        local pos = (os.clock() + clockOff) - songStart - audioOff

        local goodWindow = (type(ld[11]) == 'number' and ld[11]) or (Config.GoodWindow or 0.12)
        local horizon = goodWindow + (Config.LateGrace or 0.05) - 0.02

        for i = 1, n do
            local note = notes[i]
            if type(note) == 'table' and not note.Judged then
                local t = note.Time
                if type(t) == 'number' then
                    local dt = pos - t
                    if dt >= 0 and dt <= horizon then
                        local lane = note.Lane
                        if type(lane) == 'number' and lane >= 1 and lane <= 4 then
                            if pressLane(lane) then
                                state.lastNote[lane] = { t = t, len = tonumber(note.Length) or 0 }
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end

        for lane, info in pairs(state.lastNote) do
            if pos > info.t + info.len + 0.06 then
                engine.held[lane] = nil
                state.lastNote[lane] = nil
            end
        end
    end)
    print('[SymphonyAP] engine hooked: laneDown/onLaneAction/note-list online')
else
    warn('[SymphonyAP] engine hook FAILED: ' .. tostring(resolveErr))
end

local function setEnabled(v)
    state.enabled = v
    if not v then state.lastNote = {} end
end

local function fallbackGui()
    local gui = Instance.new('ScreenGui')
    gui.Name = 'SymphonyAutoplay'
    gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
    gui.Parent = LP:WaitForChild('PlayerGui')
    local btn = Instance.new('TextButton')
    btn.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(150, 40)
    btn.Position = UDim2.new(0.5, -75, 0, 8)
    btn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    btn.TextColor3 = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
    btn.TextSize = 16
    btn.Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium
    btn.Text = 'Autoplay: OFF'
    btn.Parent = gui
    btn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(function()
        setEnabled(not state.enabled)
        btn.Text = 'Autoplay: ' .. (state.enabled and 'ON' or 'OFF')
        btn.BackgroundColor3 = state.enabled and Color3.fromRGB(46, 160, 84) or Color3.fromRGB(40, 40, 48)
    end)
    state.win = { Destroy = function() gui:Destroy() end }
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI unavailable, using fallback toggle')
end

local windOk = pcall(function()
    local WindUI = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Footagesus/WindUI/main/dist/main.lua'))()
    assert(typeof(WindUI) == 'table' and WindUI.CreateWindow, 'WindUI load failed')

    local Window = WindUI:CreateWindow({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Folder = 'SymphonyAutoplay',
        OpenButton = { Enabled = true, Title = 'Symphony Autoplay' },
    })
    state.win = Window

    local Tab = Window:Tab({ Title = 'Autoplay', Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone' })
    Tab:Toggle({
        Title = 'Autoplay Notes',
        Desc = 'Hits every note perfectly - holds included. Start any song and watch it play itself.',
        Default = false,
        Callback = function(v)
            setEnabled(v)
            WindUI:Notify({
                Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
                Content = v and 'Enabled - start or keep playing a song.' or 'Disabled.',
                Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
                Duration = 3,
            })
        end,
    })

    WindUI:Notify({
        Title = 'Symphony Autoplay',
        Content = engine and 'Engine hooked - ready to play.' or ('Hook failed: ' .. tostring(resolveErr)),
        Icon = 'music-note-bold-duotone',
        Duration = 5,
    })
    print('[SymphonyAP] WindUI ready')
end)

if not windOk then fallbackGui() end

scripts.code:
-- Complete Smooth Physics Car Script:
-- 24-Seg 3-Spoke Wheel + Progressive Capped 6.0 Tachometer + Top-Center Rear Mirror + Top-Right 3 Buttons + Toggle/Hold Drift
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local PhysicsService = game:GetService("PhysicsService")
local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")

local player = Players.LocalPlayer
local camera = workspace.CurrentCamera
local CAR_SCALE = 1.35
local ENTER_DISTANCE = 16

-- Speed Modes: Mode 1 = 90 MPH, Mode 2 = 160 MPH
local SPEED_MODES = {
	[1] = {
		label = "1: 90 MPH",
		maxForward = 90,
		maxReverse = -28,
		gasAccel = 10,
	},
	[2] = {
		label = "2: 160 MPH",
		maxForward = 160,
		maxReverse = -42,
		gasAccel = 18,
	},
}

local currentSpeedMode = 1
local MAX_FORWARD_SPEED = SPEED_MODES[1].maxForward
local MAX_REVERSE_SPEED = SPEED_MODES[1].maxReverse
local GAS_ACCEL_RATE = SPEED_MODES[1].gasAccel
local BRAKE_DECEL_RATE = 45
local COAST_DECEL_RATE = 2.5
local STUDS_TO_MPH = 1

local TIRE_WIDTH = 0.82
local TIRE_DIAMETER = 1.95
local WHEEL_RADIUS = (TIRE_DIAMETER * 0.5) * CAR_SCALE

local GEARS = {
	{ minRatio = 0.00, maxRatio = 0.20 }, -- 1st
	{ minRatio = 0.20, maxRatio = 0.38 }, -- 2nd
	{ minRatio = 0.38, maxRatio = 0.58 }, -- 3rd
	{ minRatio = 0.58, maxRatio = 0.76 }, -- 4th
	{ minRatio = 0.76, maxRatio = 0.90 }, -- 5th
	{ minRatio = 0.90, maxRatio = 1.00 }, -- 6th
}

local MAX_RPM = 6.0
local MAX_STEER_RAD = math.rad(22)
local HOLD_THRESHOLD = 0.24

-- Collision groups
local WHEEL_GROUP = "SmoothPhysWheels_Client"
local BODY_GROUP = "SmoothPhysBody_Client"
pcall(function()
	PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(WHEEL_GROUP)
	PhysicsService:RegisterCollisionGroup(BODY_GROUP)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(WHEEL_GROUP, BODY_GROUP, false)
	PhysicsService:CollisionGroupSetCollidable(WHEEL_GROUP, WHEEL_GROUP, false)
end)

local function setGroupSafe(part, groupName)
	if not part then return end
	pcall(function()
		part.CollisionGroup = groupName
	end)
end

local thirdPersonMode = false

local function applyOutsideCameraMode(isThirdPerson)
	pcall(function()
		if isThirdPerson then
			player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.Classic
			player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 6
			player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 20
			camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
		else
			player.CameraMode = Enum.CameraMode.LockFirstPerson
			player.CameraMinZoomDistance = 0.5
			player.CameraMaxZoomDistance = 0.5
		end
	end)
end

applyOutsideCameraMode(false)

local function hideCharacterParts(char)
	if not char then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		pcall(function()
			if obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Decal") then
				obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
			elseif obj:IsA("Accessory") and obj:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
				obj.Handle.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function showCharacterParts(char)
	if not char then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		pcall(function()
			if obj:IsA("BasePart") or obj:IsA("Decal") then
				obj.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
			elseif obj:IsA("Accessory") and obj:FindFirstChild("Handle") then
				obj.Handle.LocalTransparencyModifier = 0
			end
		end)
	end
end

local function makeCharacterInvisibleLocal(char)
	if not char then return end
	task.spawn(function()
		pcall(function()
			char:WaitForChild("Humanoid", 5)
		end)
		if not thirdPersonMode then
			hideCharacterParts(char)
		end
		char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(desc)
			pcall(function()
				if not thirdPersonMode and (desc:IsA("BasePart") or desc:IsA("Decal")) then
					desc.LocalTransparencyModifier = 1
				end
			end)
		end)
	end)
end

if player.Character then
	makeCharacterInvisibleLocal(player.Character)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(makeCharacterInvisibleLocal)

local function spawnFullRallyCar()
	local char = player.Character or player.CharacterAdded:Wait()
	local root = char:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	if not root then
		warn("HumanoidRootPart not found.")
		return
	end

	local old = workspace:FindFirstChild("LocalRallyCar_Client")
	if old then old:Destroy() end

	local model = Instance.new("Model")
	model.Name = "LocalRallyCar_Client"

	local flatLook = Vector3.new(root.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, root.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
	if flatLook.Magnitude < 0.01 then
		flatLook = Vector3.new(0, 0, -1)
	else
		flatLook = flatLook.Unit
	end
	local spawnPos = root.Position + flatLook * 14 + Vector3.new(0, 3.5, 0)
	local baseCF = CFrame.lookAt(spawnPos, spawnPos + flatLook)

	local function sVec(x, y, z)
		return Vector3.new(x * CAR_SCALE, y * CAR_SCALE, z * CAR_SCALE)
	end

	local function sOff(x, y, z)
		return CFrame.new(x * CAR_SCALE, y * CAR_SCALE, z * CAR_SCALE)
	end

	local function makePart(name, size, cf, color, mat, collide, trans, shape, massless, group)
		local p = Instance.new("Part")
		p.Name = name
		p.Size = size
		p.CFrame = cf
		p.Color = color
		p.Material = mat or Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		p.CanCollide = (collide == true)
		p.Transparency = trans or 0
		p.Anchored = false
		p.Massless = (massless == true)
		if shape then
			p.Shape = shape
		end
		p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
		setGroupSafe(p, group or BODY_GROUP)
		p.Parent = model
		return p
	end

	local function weldParts(partA, partB, massless)
		if not partA or not partB or partA == partB then return end
		if massless ~= nil then
			partB.Massless = massless
		end
		local w = Instance.new("WeldConstraint")
		w.Part0 = partA
		w.Part1 = partB
		w.Parent = partB
		return w
	end

	-- Palette
	local bodyBrown = Color3.fromRGB(108, 66, 39)
	local shadeBrown = Color3.fromRGB(76, 45, 25)
	local interiorDark = Color3.fromRGB(26, 25, 27)
	local dashRed = Color3.fromRGB(156, 34, 28)
	local seatCharcoal = Color3.fromRGB(40, 41, 44)
	local passengerTan = Color3.fromRGB(128, 88, 58)
	local wellDark = Color3.fromRGB(14, 15, 18)
	local trimDark = Color3.fromRGB(22, 23, 26)
	local tireRubber = Color3.fromRGB(22, 22, 24)
	local rimSilver = Color3.fromRGB(182, 188, 196)
	local glassTint = Color3.fromRGB(135, 178, 205)
	local dialFace = Color3.fromRGB(18, 20, 24)
	local tickWhite = Color3.fromRGB(235, 238, 242)
	local needleRed = Color3.fromRGB(245, 65, 38)

	-- Main Physics Chassis
	local chassis = makePart("ChassisFloor", sVec(4.5, 0.72, 12.1), baseCF, bodyBrown, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, true, 0, nil, false, BODY_GROUP)
	chassis.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(4.0, 0.3, 0.0, 1.0, 0.5)
	model.PrimaryPart = chassis

	-- Visual Body Root welded via a Motor6D

	local function buildRoundGauge(name, localOff, radius, minAngleRad, maxAngleRad, tickThick, needleThick)
		local gCenter = chassis.CFrame * localOff
		attachBody(makePart(name .. "_Bezel", sVec(radius * 2.12, radius * 2.12, 0.07), gCenter, trimDark, Enum.Material.Metal, false, 0))
		attachBody(makePart(name .. "_Face", sVec(radius * 1.92, radius * 1.92, 0.05), gCenter * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.015), dialFace, Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic, false, 0))

		for t = -5, 5 do
			local ang = math.rad(t * 24)
			local tx = math.sin(ang) * (radius * 0.75)
			local ty = math.cos(ang) * (radius * 0.75)
			local tLen = (t % 2 == 0) and (radius * 0.17) or (radius * 0.11)
			attachBody(makePart(
				name .. "_Tick_" .. t,
				sVec(tickThick, tLen, 0.025),
				gCenter * CFrame.new(tx, ty, 0.045) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -ang),
				tickWhite,
				Enum.Material.Neon,
				false,
				0
			))
		end

		local nLen = radius * 0.68
		local needleHub = makePart(
			name .. "_NeedlePivot",
			sVec(0.04, 0.04, 0.03),
			gCenter * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.06),
			needleRed,
			Enum.Material.Neon,
			false,
			1,
			nil,
			true
		)
		local needleJoint = Instance.new("Motor6D")
		needleJoint.Name = name .. "_NeedleJoint"
		needleJoint.Part0 = bodyRoot
		needleJoint.Part1 = needleHub
		needleJoint.C0 = localOff * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.06)
		needleJoint.C1 = CFrame.identity
		needleJoint.Parent = needleHub

		local needleBlade = makePart(
			name .. "_NeedleBlade",
			sVec(needleThick, nLen, 0.02),
			needleHub.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, nLen * 0.35, 0.01),
			needleRed,
			Enum.Material.Neon,
			false,
			0,
			nil,
			true
		)
		weldParts(needleHub, needleBlade, true)

		local centerCap = makePart(
			name .. "_CenterCap",
			sVec(radius * 0.18, radius * 0.18, 0.03),
			needleHub.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 0, 0.015),
			trimDark,
			Enum.Material.Metal,
			false,
			0,
			Enum.PartType.Cylinder,
			true
		)
		weldParts(needleHub, centerCap, true)

		return function(ratio01)
			local r = math.clamp(ratio01, 0, 1)
			local ang = minAngleRad + (maxAngleRad - minAngleRad) * r
			needleJoint.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, -ang)
		end
	end

	local setSpeedoNeedle = buildRoundGauge("SpeedometerDial", sOff(-0.96, 1.50, -1.04), 0.25, math.rad(-125), math.rad(125), 0.008, 0.010)
	table.insert(needleUpdaters, function(mphVal, rpmVal)

	-- ==================== MIRROR WORLD SYNC (WORLD + OTHER PLAYERS + CAR + SHADOWS) ====================
	local mirrorEntries = {}
	local lastMirrorSync = 0

	local function clearMirrorEntries()
		for _, entry in ipairs(mirrorEntries) do
			if entry.clone and entry.clone.Parent then entry.clone:Destroy() end
			if entry.shadowClone and entry.shadowClone.Parent then entry.shadowClone:Destroy() end
		end
		table.clear(mirrorEntries)
	end

	local function createMirrorPartFrom(srcPart)
		local ok, cl = pcall(function()
			local p = Instance.new("Part")
			p.Name = "MirrorObj"
			p.Shape = srcPart:IsA("Part") and srcPart.Shape or Enum.PartType.Block
			p.Size = srcPart.Size
			p.CFrame = srcPart.CFrame
			p.Color = srcPart.Color
			p.Material = srcPart.Material
			p.Transparency = math.clamp(srcPart.Transparency, 0, 0.85)
			p.Anchored = true
			p.CanCollide = false
			p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
			p.Parent = mirrorWorldModel
			return p
		end)
		return ok and cl or nil
	end

	local function syncMirrorWorld()
		clearMirrorEntries()
		local count = 0
		local maxParts = 420

		for _, desc in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if count >= maxParts then break end
			if desc:IsA("BasePart")
				and desc ~= skyDomePart
				and desc ~= horizonBandPart
				and desc ~= sunDiscPart
				and desc ~= centerMirrorGlass
				and not desc:IsDescendantOf(mirrorWorldModel)
				and desc.Transparency < 0.98
				and desc.Size.Magnitude > 0.1
			then
				local dist = (desc.Position - chassis.Position).Magnitude
				if dist < 280 then
					local isSelfChar = player.Character and desc:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
					if not isSelfChar then
						local cl = createMirrorPartFrom(desc)
						if cl then
							local shadowCl = nil
							if desc.Size.Y < 20 and desc.Position.Y > chassis.Position.Y - 3.0 then
								local okS, sPart = pcall(function()
									local sp = Instance.new("Part")
									sp.Name = "MirrorShadow"
									sp.Size = Vector3.new(math.max(1.2, desc.Size.X * 1.05), 0.08, math.max(1.2, desc.Size.Z * 1.05))
									sp.Color = Color3.fromRGB(16, 20, 28)
									sp.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
									sp.Transparency = 0.45
									sp.Anchored = true
									sp.CanCollide = false
									sp.Parent = mirrorWorldModel
									return sp
								end)
								if okS and sPart then
									shadowCl = sPart
								end
							end
							table.insert(mirrorEntries, {
								source = desc,
								clone = cl,
								shadowClone = shadowCl,
							})
							count += 1
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	local function updateMirrorPartPositions()
		local lightDir = Lighting:GetSunDirection()
		local sunOffset = (lightDir.Magnitude > 0.01) and (lightDir.Unit * 340) or Vector3.new(160, 220, 140)
		skyDomePart.CFrame = CFrame.new(chassis.Position)
		horizonBandPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(chassis.Position) * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, math.rad(90))
		sunDiscPart.CFrame = CFrame.new(chassis.Position + sunOffset)

		for _, entry in ipairs(mirrorEntries) do
			if entry.source and entry.source.Parent and entry.clone and entry.clone.Parent then
				entry.clone.CFrame = entry.source.CFrame
				if entry.shadowClone and entry.shadowClone.Parent then
					local groundY = chassis.Position.Y - (0.72 * CAR_SCALE)
					local dy = math.max(0, entry.source.Position.Y - groundY)
					local shiftX = -(lightDir.X / math.max(0.25, lightDir.Y)) * dy * 0.45
					local shiftZ = -(lightDir.Z / math.max(0.25, lightDir.Y)) * dy * 0.45
					entry.shadowClone.CFrame = CFrame.new(
						entry.source.Position.X + shiftX,
						groundY + 0.04,
						entry.source.Position.Z + shiftZ
					)
				end
			end
		end
	end

	-- Drift: Tap once = ON until tapped again to turn OFF; Hold = ON while held, OFF when released
	local touchGas, touchRev, touchLeft, touchRight = false, false, false, false
	local driftToggledOn = false
	local driftHolding = false
	local driftPressClock = 0
	local driftBeganAsToggle = false

	local function onDriftInputBegan()
		driftPressClock = os.clock()
		driftHolding = true
		if not driftToggledOn then
			driftToggledOn = true
			driftBeganAsToggle = true
		else
			driftBeganAsToggle = false
		end
	end

	local function onDriftInputEnded()
		if not driftHolding then return end
		local heldTime = os.clock() - driftPressClock
		driftHolding = false
		if heldTime <= HOLD_THRESHOLD then
			if not driftBeganAsToggle then
				driftToggledOn = false
			end
		else
			driftToggledOn = false
		end
		driftBeganAsToggle = false
	end

	driftBtn.MouseButton1Down:Connect(onDriftInputBegan)
	driftBtn.MouseButton1Up:Connect(onDriftInputEnded)
	driftBtn.MouseLeave:Connect(onDriftInputEnded)
	driftBtn.InputBegan:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			onDriftInputBegan()
		end
	end)
	driftBtn.InputEnded:Connect(function(inp)
		if inp.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			onDriftInputEnded()
		end
	end)

	local lastHitTime = 0
	chassis.Touched:Connect(function(hit)
		if not hit or not hit.CanCollide then return end
		if hit:IsDescendantOf(model) then return end
		if player.Character and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then return end

		local deltaPos = hit.Position - chassis.Position
		local horizDist = Vector3.new(deltaPos.X, 0, deltaPos.Z).Magnitude
		local vertDist = math.abs(deltaPos.Y)
		if deltaPos.Y < -0.2 and horizDist < vertDist * 1.4 then
			return
		end

		local now = os.clock()
		if now - lastHitTime < 0.25 then return end

		local realForwardSpeed = chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(chassis.CFrame.LookVector)
		local speedDiff = math.abs(targetSpeed - realForwardSpeed)
		if math.abs(targetSpeed) > 16 and speedDiff > 14 then
			lastHitTime = now
			targetSpeed = realForwardSpeed * 0.65
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if not isSeated then return end
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			camYaw = camYaw - input.Delta.X * SENSITIVITY
			camPitch = math.clamp(camPitch - input.Delta.Y * SENSITIVITY, math.rad(-80), math.rad(80))
		end
	end)

	local function setDriveControlsVisible(vis)
		exitBtn.Visible = vis
		speedModeBtn.Visible = vis
		leftBtn.Visible = vis
		rightBtn.Visible = vis
		driftBtn.Visible = vis
		gasBtn.Visible = vis
		revBtn.Visible = vis
		speedLabel.Visible = vis
		mirrorSurfaceGui.Enabled = vis and (not thirdPersonMode)
		if mirrorSurfaceGui.Enabled and os.clock() - lastMirrorSync > 1.5 then
			lastMirrorSync = os.clock()
			syncMirrorWorld()
		end
	end

	local function computeGear(mph, throttle, isReversing)
		if isReversing then return "R" end
		if mph < 1.0 and throttle <= 0 then return "N" end
		local ratio = math.clamp(mph / math.max(1, MAX_FORWARD_SPEED), 0, 1)
		for g = 1, #GEARS do
			if ratio <= GEARS[g].maxRatio then return g end
		end
		return 6
	end

	local function computeTargetRpm(mph, gear, throttle, isDrifting)
		if gear == "N" then
			return (throttle > 0) and 3.8 or 1.0
		elseif gear == "R" then
			local revRatio = math.clamp(mph / math.max(1, math.abs(MAX_REVERSE_SPEED)), 0, 1)
			return math.min(MAX_RPM, 1.3 + revRatio * 4.2)
		elseif type(gear) == "number" and GEARS[gear] then
			local gData = GEARS[gear]
			local minMph = gData.minRatio * MAX_FORWARD_SPEED
			local maxMph = gData.maxRatio * MAX_FORWARD_SPEED
			local span = math.max(1, maxMph - minMph)
			local ratio = math.clamp((mph - minMph) / span, 0, 1)
			local baseRpm = 1.5 + ratio * 4.0
			if throttle > 0 then
				baseRpm = math.min(MAX_RPM, baseRpm + 0.3)
			end
			if isDrifting then
				baseRpm = math.min(MAX_RPM, baseRpm + 0.5)
			end
			return math.clamp(baseRpm, 0, MAX_RPM)
		end
		return 1.0
	end

	local function sitInCar()
		local c = player.Character
		if not c then return end
		local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local hrp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if not hum or not hrp then return end

		camYaw = 0
		camPitch = thirdPersonMode and 0.16 or 0.04
		physBounceY = 0
		physSurgeZ = 0
		physHeadRoll = 0
		prevVelY = chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
		prevForwardVel = chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(chassis.CFrame.LookVector)
		currentGear = "N"
		currentRpm = 1.0
		isSeated = true
		enterBtn.Visible = false
		setDriveControlsVisible(true)
		syncMirrorWorld()
		lastMirrorSync = os.clock()
		refreshCamButtonAndCharacter()
		hum.Sit = true
		applySeatLock(c)
	end

	local function exitCar()
		clearSeatLock()
		touchGas, touchRev, touchLeft, touchRight = false, false, false, false
		driftToggledOn = false
		driftHolding = false
		driftBeganAsToggle = false
		targetSpeed = 0
		steerAngle = 0
		driftTiltAngle = 0
		physBounceY = 0
		physSurgeZ = 0
		physHeadRoll = 0
		driftSlideForce.Force = Vector3.zero
		bodyTiltJoint.Transform = CFrame.identity
		steeringWheelJoint.Transform = CFrame.identity
		currentGear = "N"
		currentRpm = 1.0
		camYaw = 0
		camPitch = 0.12
		turnAngVel.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
		speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		speedLabel.Text = "[N] TACH 1.0 | SPEED 000 MPH"
		for _, h in ipairs(spinHinges) do
			h.AngularVelocity = 0
		end
		local c = player.Character
		if not c then return end
		local hum = c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		local hrp = c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hum then hum.Sit = false end
		isSeated = false
		setDriveControlsVisible(false)
		if hrp then
			hrp.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
			hrp.CFrame = chassis.CFrame * CFrame.new(-5.5 * CAR_SCALE, 2.5, 0)
		end
		refreshCamButtonAndCharacter()
	end

	enterBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(sitInCar)
	exitBtn.MouseButton1Click:Connect(exitCar)

	UserInputService.InputBegan:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if gp then return end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.E then
			if isSeated then exitCar() elseif enterBtn.Visible then sitInCar() end
		elseif input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.C then
			toggleCameraView()
		elseif isSeated and input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.M then
			applySpeedMode((currentSpeedMode == 1) and 2 or 1)
		elseif isSeated and (input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift) then
			onDriftInputBegan()
		end
	end)

	UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input, gp)
		if gp then return end
		if input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.Space or input.KeyCode == Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift then
			onDriftInputEnded()
		end
	end)

	RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
		if not chassis or not chassis.Parent then return end
		dt = math.min(dt, 0.05)

		local c = player.Character
		local hrp = c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		local hum = c and c:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

		if not isSeated then
			clearSeatLock()
			turnAngVel.AngularVelocity = Vector3.zero
			driftSlideForce.Force = Vector3.zero
			driftTiltAngle = driftTiltAngle + (0 - driftTiltAngle) * math.min(1, 10 * dt)
			physBounceY = physBounceY + (0 - physBounceY) * math.min(1, 12 * dt)
			physSurgeZ = physSurgeZ + (0 - physSurgeZ) * math.min(1, 12 * dt)
			physHeadRoll = physHeadRoll + (0 - physHeadRoll) * math.min(1, 12 * dt)
			if math.abs(targetSpeed) <= COAST_DECEL_RATE * dt then
				targetSpeed = 0
			else
				targetSpeed -= math.sign(targetSpeed) * COAST_DECEL_RATE * dt
			end
			for _, h in ipairs(spinHinges) do
				h.AngularVelocity = -targetSpeed / WHEEL_RADIUS
			end
			currentRpm = currentRpm + (1.0 - currentRpm) * math.min(1, 8 * dt)
			setDriveControlsVisible(false)
			if hrp then
				local dist = (hrp.Position - chassis.Position).Magnitude
				enterBtn.Visible = (dist <= ENTER_DISTANCE)
			end
			return
		end

		enterBtn.Visible = false
		setDriveControlsVisible(true)
		if hum and not hum.Sit then hum.Sit = true end
		if hrp and (not seatLockWeld or not seatLockWeld.Parent) then
			applySeatLock(c)
		end

		local isDrifting = driftToggledOn or driftHolding
		if isDrifting then
			driftBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(235, 135, 35)
			driftBtn.Text = "DRIFT ON"
		else
			driftBtn.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(145, 92, 34)
			driftBtn.Text = "DRIFT"
		end

		local throttle = 0
		if touchGas or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Up) then throttle += 1 end
		if touchRev or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Down) then throttle -= 1 end

		-- +1 = LEFT, -1 = RIGHT
		local steerInput = 0
		if touchLeft or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Left) then steerInput += 1 end
		if touchRight or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Right) then steerInput -= 1 end

		local horizVel = Vector3.new(chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z)
		local forwardVel = chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(chassis.CFrame.LookVector)
		local actualSpeed = horizVel.Magnitude
		local mphNow = actualSpeed * STUDS_TO_MPH

		currentGear = computeGear(mphNow, throttle, (throttle < 0 and targetSpeed <= 0.5) or (targetSpeed < -0.5 and throttle <= 0))

		if throttle > 0 then
			if targetSpeed < 0 then
				targetSpeed = math.min(0, targetSpeed + BRAKE_DECEL_RATE * dt)
			else
				targetSpeed = math.min(MAX_FORWARD_SPEED, targetSpeed + GAS_ACCEL_RATE * dt)
			end
		elseif throttle < 0 then
			if targetSpeed > 0.25 then
				targetSpeed = math.max(0, targetSpeed - BRAKE_DECEL_RATE * dt)
			else
				targetSpeed = math.max(MAX_REVERSE_SPEED, targetSpeed - GAS_ACCEL_RATE * dt)
			end
		else
			local decel = isDrifting and (COAST_DECEL_RATE * 1.4) or COAST_DECEL_RATE
			if math.abs(targetSpeed) <= decel * dt then
				targetSpeed = 0
			else
				targetSpeed -= math.sign(targetSpeed) * decel * dt
			end
		end

		-- Progressive Tachometer: each +1.0 takes longer as RPM approaches 6.0 and speed rises
		local goalRpm = computeTargetRpm(mphNow, currentGear, throttle, isDrifting)
		local rpmDiff = goalRpm - currentRpm
		if rpmDiff > 0 then
			local highRpmFactor = math.clamp(1 - (currentRpm / MAX_RPM) * 0.72, 0.22, 1.0)
			local speedLoadFactor = math.clamp(1 - (mphNow / math.max(1, MAX_FORWARD_SPEED)) * 0.35, 0.60, 1.0)
			local climbSpeed = 8.5 * highRpmFactor * speedLoadFactor
			currentRpm = math.min(MAX_RPM, currentRpm + rpmDiff * math.min(1, climbSpeed * dt))
		else
			local fallSpeed = (throttle <= 0) and 6.5 or 9.0
			currentRpm = math.max(0, currentRpm + rpmDiff * math.min(1, fallSpeed * dt))
		end

		local braking = (throttle < 0 and targetSpeed > 0.25) or (throttle > 0 and targetSpeed < 0)
		for _, tl in ipairs(taillights) do
			if tl and tl.Parent then
				tl.Color = braking and Color3.fromRGB(255, 55, 55) or Color3.fromRGB(175, 25, 25)
			end
		end

		local wheelAngVel = -targetSpeed / WHEEL_RADIUS
		for _, h in ipairs(spinHinges) do
			h.AngularVelocity = wheelAngVel
		end

		for _, wEntry in ipairs(wheelParts) do
			if wEntry.isRear and wEntry.part then
				local targetFriction = isDrifting and 0.12 or 0.9
				wEntry.part.CustomPhysicalProperties = PhysicalProperties.new(1.5, targetFriction, 0.0, 1.0, 0.5)
			end
		end

		local steerMult = isDrifting and 1.45 or 1.0
		local goalSteer = math.clamp(steerInput * MAX_STEER_RAD * steerMult, -math.rad(34), math.rad(34))
		steerAngle = steerAngle + (goalSteer - steerAngle) * math.min(1, 10 * dt)
		for _, fData in ipairs(frontSteerData) do
			fData.cAtt.CFrame = fData.baseCFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, steerAngle, 0)
		end

		local moveFactor = math.clamp(actualSpeed / 14, 0, 1)
		local revSign = (forwardVel < -0.5) and -1 or 1
		local driftTurnBoost = isDrifting and 1.95 or 1.0
		local yawRate = steerInput * 1.45 * driftTurnBoost * moveFactor * revSign
		turnAngVel.AngularVelocity = Vector3.new(0, yawRate, 0)

		if isDrifting and math.abs(steerInput) > 0 and actualSpeed > 12 then
			local mass = chassis.AssemblyMass
			local slideDir = chassis.CFrame.RightVector * (-steerInput)
			local slideAccel = math.clamp(actualSpeed * 0.48, 8, 36)
			driftSlideForce.Force = slideDir * (mass * slideAccel)
		else
			driftSlideForce.Force = Vector3.zero
		end

		local speedTiltFactor = math.clamp(actualSpeed / 45, 0.25, 1)
		local maxTilt = isDrifting and math.rad(11.5) or math.rad(4.0)
		local goalTilt = steerInput * maxTilt * speedTiltFactor
		driftTiltAngle = driftTiltAngle + (goalTilt - driftTiltAngle) * math.min(1, 10 * dt)

		local velY = chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Y
		local vertAccel = (velY - prevVelY) / math.max(dt, 0.001)
		prevVelY = velY

		local fwdAccel = (forwardVel - prevForwardVel) / math.max(dt, 0.001)
		prevForwardVel = forwardVel

		local targetBounceY = math.clamp(-vertAccel * 0.0045, -0.14, 0.14)
		local targetSurgeZ = math.clamp(fwdAccel * 0.006, -0.18, 0.18)
		local lateralSpeed = chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity:Dot(chassis.CFrame.RightVector)
		local targetHeadRoll = math.clamp(-lateralSpeed * 0.0045, math.rad(-5.5), math.rad(5.5))

		physBounceY = physBounceY + (targetBounceY - physBounceY) * math.min(1, 14 * dt)
		physSurgeZ = physSurgeZ + (targetSurgeZ - physSurgeZ) * math.min(1, 12 * dt)
		physHeadRoll = physHeadRoll + (targetHeadRoll - physHeadRoll) * math.min(1, 12 * dt)
	end)

	RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
		if not chassis or not chassis.Parent then return end
		local mphNow = Vector3.new(chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity.X, 0, chassis.AssemblyLinearVelocity.Z).Magnitude * STUDS_TO_MPH
		local mph = math.clamp(math.floor(mphNow + 0.5), 0, 999)
		speedLabel.Text = string.format("[%s] TACH %.1f | SPEED %03d MPH", tostring(currentGear), currentRpm, mph)
		if currentRpm >= 5.6 then
			speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 95, 85)
		elseif currentRpm >= 4.6 then
			speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 210, 90)
		else
			speedLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		end

		for _, updater in ipairs(needleUpdaters) do
			updater(mphNow, currentRpm)
		end

		if bodyTiltJoint then
			bodyTiltJoint.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, 0, driftTiltAngle)
		end

		if steeringWheelJoint then
			steeringWheelJoint.Transform = CFrame.Angles(0, steerAngle * 2.2, 0)
		end

		if isSeated then
			if player.Character then
				if thirdPersonMode then
					showCharacterParts(player.Character)
				else
					hideCharacterParts(player.Character)
				end
			end

			local baseRot = chassis.CFrame.Rotation
			local lookRot = baseRot * CFrame.Angles(0, camYaw, 0) * CFrame.Angles(camPitch, 0, 0)
			camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Scriptable

			if thirdPersonMode then
				mirrorSurfaceGui.Enabled = false
				local pivotPos = (chassis.CFrame * sOff(0, 2.2, 0)).Position
				local camPos = pivotPos - lookRot.LookVector * (14 * CAR_SCALE) + Vector3.new(0, 2.2, 0)
				camera.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(camPos, pivotPos)
			else
				mirrorSurfaceGui.Enabled = true
				local eyeCF = bodyRoot.CFrame * sOff(-1.25, 1.84, -0.05) * CFrame.new(0, physBounceY, physSurgeZ)
				camera.CFrame = CFrame.new(eyeCF.Position) * lookRot * CFrame.Angles(0, 0, physHeadRoll)

				if os.clock() - lastMirrorSync > 1.5 then
					lastMirrorSync = os.clock()
					syncMirrorWorld()
				end
				updateMirrorPartPositions()

				if centerMirrorGlass then
					local flatBackDir = Vector3.new(-chassis.CFrame.LookVector.X, 0, -chassis.CFrame.LookVector.Z)
					if flatBackDir.Magnitude < 0.01 then
						flatBackDir = Vector3.new(0, 0, 1)
					else
						flatBackDir = flatBackDir.Unit
					end
					local mirrorOrigin = (chassis.CFrame * sOff(0, 2.15, 7.8)).Position
					local lookTarget = mirrorOrigin + flatBackDir * 60 + Vector3.new(0, 1.0, 0)
					local zAxis = (mirrorOrigin - lookTarget).Unit
					local xAxis = Vector3.new(0, 1, 0):Cross(zAxis).Unit
					local yAxis = zAxis:Cross(xAxis).Unit
					-- Flip X axis so the reflection reads left-to-right like a mirror
					mirrorCam.CFrame = CFrame.fromMatrix(mirrorOrigin, -xAxis, yAxis, zAxis)
				end
			end
		else
			mirrorSurfaceGui.Enabled = false
			if camera.CameraType == Enum.CameraType.Scriptable then
				camera.CameraType = Enum.CameraType.Custom
			end
		end
	end)

	model.Parent = workspace
	print("Spawned complete car script with in-holder rear mirror, top-right 3 buttons, 90/160 MPH toggle, and toggle/hold drift!")
end

spawnFullRallyCar()

scripts.title: Weight/Mass Set Script (Universal)
scripts.author: cleberjacqueline
scripts.summary: a script that changes your characters mass
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local player = Players.LocalPlayer

local DEFAULT = 0.7
local state = {density = DEFAULT, strength = 1, press = true}

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- weight
----------------------------------------------------------------
local function props()
	return PhysicalProperties.new(state.density, 0.3, 0, 1, 1)
end

local function applyWeight(char)
	if not char then return end
	for _, p in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CustomPhysicalProperties = props() end
	end
end

local function getMass()
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	return root and root.AssemblyMass or 0
end

local function hookCharacter(char)
	task.wait(0.5)
	applyWeight(char)
	char.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(p)
		if p:IsA("BasePart") then p.CustomPhysicalProperties = props() end
	end)
end
player.CharacterAdded:Connect(hookCharacter)
if player.Character then task.spawn(hookCharacter, player.Character) end

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- press parts below
----------------------------------------------------------------
local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local cur = {part = nil, attach = nil, force = nil}

local function release()
	if cur.force then cur.force:Destroy() end
	if cur.attach then cur.attach:Destroy() end
	cur.part, cur.attach, cur.force = nil, nil, nil
end

local function isLoose(part)
	if part.Anchored then return false end
	local root = part.AssemblyRootPart
	if root and root.Anchored then return false end
	if part.Parent and part.Parent:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid") then return false end
	return true
end

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function()
	local char = player.Character
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	if not (state.press and root and hum) or hum.FloorMaterial == Enum.Material.Air then
		release()
		return
	end

	rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {char}
	local reach = hum.HipHeight + root.Size.Y / 2 + 2
	local hit = workspace:Raycast(root.Position, Vector3.new(0, -reach, 0), rayParams)
	if not (hit and isLoose(hit.Instance)) then
		release()
		return
	end

	if cur.part ~= hit.Instance then
		release()
		local a = Instance.new("Attachment")
		a.Name = "WeightPress"
		a.Parent = hit.Instance
		local f = Instance.new("VectorForce")
		f.RelativeTo = Enum.ActuatorRelativeTo.World
		f.ApplyAtCenterOfMass = false
		f.Attachment0 = a
		f.Parent = hit.Instance
		cur.part, cur.attach, cur.force = hit.Instance, a, f
	end

	cur.attach.WorldPosition = hit.Position
	cur.force.Force = Vector3.new(0, -getMass() * workspace.Gravity * state.strength, 0)
end)
player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(release)

----------------------------------------------------------------
-- gui
----------------------------------------------------------------
local BG = Color3.fromRGB(28, 28, 30)
local LINE = Color3.fromRGB(62, 62, 66)
local TEXT = Color3.fromRGB(205, 205, 205)
local DIM = Color3.fromRGB(125, 125, 130)
local ACCENT = Color3.fromRGB(222, 170, 70)
local FONT = Enum.Font.Code

local gui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
gui.Name = "WeightTool"
gui.ResetOnSpawn = false
gui.Parent = player:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")

local main = Instance.new("Frame")
main.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(230, 0)
main.AutomaticSize = Enum.AutomaticSize.Y
main.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(16, 90)
main.BackgroundColor3 = BG
main.BorderSizePixel = 0
main.Parent = gui
Instance.new("UIStroke", main).Color = LINE

local pad = Instance.new("UIPadding", main)
pad.PaddingTop, pad.PaddingBottom = UDim.new(0, 8), UDim.new(0, 10)
pad.PaddingLeft, pad.PaddingRight = UDim.new(0, 10), UDim.new(0, 10)

local list = Instance.new("UIListLayout", main)
list.Padding = UDim.new(0, 8)
list.SortOrder = Enum.SortOrder.LayoutOrder

local function label(parent, str, color, align)
	local l = Instance.new("TextLabel")
	l.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	l.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
	l.Text = str
	l.TextColor3 = color or TEXT
	l.Font = FONT
	l.TextSize = 13
	l.TextXAlignment = align or Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
	l.Parent = parent
	return l
end

local function isPress(i)
	return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end
local function isMove(i)
	return i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or i.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch
end

-- title bar: drag handle + mass readout
local bar = Instance.new("Frame")
bar.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 18)
bar.BackgroundTransparency = 1
bar.LayoutOrder = 0
bar.Parent = main
label(bar, "weight", DIM)
local massLbl = label(bar, "", TEXT, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)

do
	local dragging, startPos, startMouse
	bar.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if isPress(i) then dragging, startPos, startMouse = true, main.Position, i.Position end
	end)
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if dragging and isMove(i) then
			local d = i.Position - startMouse
			main.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(startPos.X.Offset + d.X, startPos.Y.Offset + d.Y)
		end
	end)
	UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if isPress(i) then dragging = false end
	end)
end

local function divider(order)
	local f = Instance.new("Frame")
	f.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 1)
	f.BackgroundColor3 = LINE
	f.BorderSizePixel = 0
	f.LayoutOrder = order
	f.Parent = main
end

-- log-scale slider
local function makeSlider(order, name, min, max, init, fmt, commit)
	local holder = Instance.new("Frame")
	holder.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 34)
	holder.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	holder.LayoutOrder = order
	holder.Parent = main

	label(holder, name, DIM)
	local valLbl = label(holder, "", TEXT, Enum.TextXAlignment.Right)

	local hit = Instance.new("TextButton")
	hit.Text = ""
	hit.AutoButtonColor = false
	hit.BackgroundTransparency = 1
	hit.Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 18)
	hit.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 16)
	hit.Parent = holder

	local track = Instance.new("Frame")
	track.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0, 0.5)
	track.Position = UDim2.fromScale(0, 0.5)
	track.Size = UDim2.new(1, 0, 0, 2)
	track.BackgroundColor3 = LINE
	track.BorderSizePixel = 0
	track.Parent = hit

	local fill = Instance.new("Frame")
	fill.BackgroundColor3 = ACCENT
	fill.BorderSizePixel = 0
	fill.Parent = track

	local knob = Instance.new("Frame")
	knob.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
	knob.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 14)
	knob.BackgroundColor3 = TEXT
	knob.BorderSizePixel = 0
	knob.Parent = hit

	local value = init
	local function show()
		local t = math.log(value / min) / math.log(max / min)
		fill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(t, 1)
		knob.Position = UDim2.new(t, 0, 0.5, 0)
		valLbl.Text = fmt(value)
	end
	show()

	local dragging = false
	local function fromX(x)
		local t = math.clamp((x - hit.AbsolutePosition.X) / hit.AbsoluteSize.X, 0, 1)
		value = math.floor(min * (max / min) ^ t * 100 + 0.5) / 100
		value = math.clamp(value, min, max)
		show()
	end

	hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(i)
		if isPress(i) then dragging = true fromX(i.Position.X) end
	end)
	UIS.InputChanged:Connect(function(i)
		if dragging and isMove(i) then fromX(i.Position.X) end
	end)
	UIS.InputEnded:Connect(function(i)
		if dragging and isPress(i) then
			dragging = false
			commit(value)
		end
	end)

	return {
		set = function(v)
			value = math.clamp(v, min, max)
			show()
			commit(value)
		end,
	}
end

scripts.code:
if getgenv().patchmaskid =="gay" then return end
getgenv().patchmaskid ="gay"

local IN=Instance.new
local V3=Vector3.new
local C3=Color3.new
local V2=Vector2.new
local CF=CFrame.new
local NS=NumberSequence.new
local NSK=NumberSequenceKeypoint.new
local UD2=UDim2.fromScale
local SafeSvc=setmetatable({}, {__index=function(t, n) local s=cloneref(game:GetService(n)) t[n]=s return s end})
local clock=os.clock
local floor=math.floor
local ceil=math.ceil
local abs=math.abs
local max=math.max
local min=math.min
local rand=math.random
local rad=math.rad
local deg=math.deg
local tan=math.tan
local atan=math.atan
local exp=math.exp
local clamp=math.clamp
local huge=math.huge
local AIR=Enum.Material.Air
local R6=Enum.HumanoidRigType.R6
local refs={}
local fr=0
local slotN=0
local vis=true
local nm=0
local nb=0
local mir={}
local bl={}
local pc={}
local tracked={}
local npcSet={}
local npcPending={}
local watch={"BasePart","Accessory","Clothing","ShirtGraphic","BodyColors","CharacterMesh","SurfaceAppearance","WrapLayer","Humanoid"}
local OFFS={V3(0,0,0),V3(0.35,0,0),V3(-0.35,0,0),V3(0,0.35,0),V3(0,-0.35,0),V3(0,0,0.35),V3(0,0,-0.35)}
local NOFFS=#OFFS
local CULL_DIST=150
local BLK_DIST=60
local STEP2_DIST=110
local NPC_MAX=8
local NPC_RANGE=70
local NPC_DESPAWN=NPC_RANGE * 1.25
local ALPHA_RATE=12
local SCAN_IV=0.25
local SLOW_IV=0.25
local DIRTY_DELAY=0.1
local FADE_T=0.1
local AIR_STATE={[Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping]=true, [Enum.HumanoidStateType.Freefall]=true}
local OWN_PARTS={LeftFoot=true,RightFoot=true,["Left Leg"]=true,["Right Leg"]=true,LeftLowerLeg=true,RightLowerLeg=true}
local pt, gui, vpf, vcam
local lVs, lFov, lIT
local frameConn

function rmRef(key, r)
r=refs[key]
if r then
refs[key]=nil
if r.npc then tracked[key]=nil end
for _, cn in ipairs(r.conns) do cn:Disconnect() end
if r.clone then r.clone:Destroy() end
end
end

function mcf(oc, fy, x, y, z, r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22)
x, y, z, r00, r01, r02, r10, r11, r12, r20, r21, r22=oc:GetComponents()
return CF(x, (2 * fy) - y, z, -r00, r01, r02, r10, -r11, -r12, -r20, r21, r22)
end

function pTree(a, b, out, pool, used, k, m)
pool={}
for _, ch in ipairs(b:GetChildren()) do
pool[ch.Name]=pool[ch.Name] or {}
table.insert(pool[ch.Name], ch)
end
used={}
for _, ch in ipairs(a:GetChildren()) do
k=ch.Name
used[k]=(used[k] or 0) + 1
m=pool[k] and pool[k][used[k]]
if m and m.ClassName == ch.ClassName then
if ch:IsA("BasePart") then
table.insert(out, {ch, m, f=0, tg=0, rOn=false, vis=true})
end
pTree(ch, m, out)
end end end

function cRad(r, m, x)
m=4
for _, p in ipairs(r.pairs) do
if p[1].Parent then
x=(p[1].Position - r.hrp.Position).Magnitude + p.qr
if x > m then m=x end
end end
r.mrad=m + 2
end


function calcHH(r, h, v, leg)
h=r.hum
if not h then return end
v=h.HipHeight + r.hrp.Size.Y * 0.5
if h.RigType == R6 then
leg=r.char:FindFirstChild("Left Leg")
if leg then v=v + leg.Size.Y end
end
r.hh=v
end


function lowest(r, m, y)
m=huge
for _, p in ipairs(r.pairs) do
if p[1].Parent then
y=p[1].Position.Y - p.hy
if y < m then m=y end
end end
return m ~= huge and m or nil
end

function bld(r, cln, prs)
if r.clone then r.clone:Destroy() r.clone=nil end
r.pairs={}
r.char.Archivable=true
cln=r.char:Clone()
if not cln then return end
prs={}
pTree(r.char, cln, prs)
for _, v in ipairs(cln:GetDescendants()) do
if v:IsA("LuaSourceContainer") or v:IsA("Sound") or v:IsA("BillboardGui") or v:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or v:IsA("Trail") or v:IsA("Beam") or v:IsA("Light") or v:IsA("Fire") or v:IsA("Smoke") or v:IsA("Sparkles") or v:IsA("ForceField") or v:IsA("Highlight") then
v:Destroy()
elseif v:IsA("Humanoid") then
v.DisplayDistanceType=Enum.HumanoidDisplayDistanceType.None
v.HealthDisplayType=Enum.HumanoidHealthDisplayType.AlwaysOff
end
end
for _, p in ipairs(prs) do
p[2].Anchored=true
p[2].CanCollide=false
p[2].CastShadow=false
p[2].Material=Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
p.sz=p[1].Size
p.hx=p.sz.X * 0.5
p.hy=p.sz.Y * 0.5
p.hz=p.sz.Z * 0.5
p.qr=p.sz.Magnitude * 0.5
p.own=(r.isLocal and OWN_PARTS[p[1].Name]) and true or false
if p[1] == r.hrp and r.hrp.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" then
p.root=true
p[2].Transparency=1
end
end
r.clone=cln
r.pairs=prs
r.scale=r.char:GetScale()
r.lfy=nil
r.hum=r.char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
calcHH(r)
cRad(r)
end

function sTick(r)
if r.scale ~= r.char:GetScale() then bld(r) return end
for _, p in ipairs(r.pairs) do
if p[1].Parent and p[1].Size ~= p.sz then
p.sz=p[1].Size
p[2].Size=p.sz
p.hx=p.sz.X * 0.5
p.hy=p.sz.Y * 0.5
p.hz=p.sz.Z * 0.5
p.qr=p.sz.Magnitude * 0.5
end
end
calcHH(r)
cRad(r)
end

function addRef(key, c, npc, hrp, r, mkDrt)
if refs[key] and refs[key].char == c then return end
rmRef(key)
hrp=c:WaitForChild("HumanoidRootPart", npc and 3 or 5)
if not hrp and npc then
hrp=c.PrimaryPart or c:FindFirstChild("Torso") or c:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or c:FindFirstChild("Head")
end
if not hrp or not vpf then return end
if npc then
if not c.Parent then return end
else
if not key.Parent or key.Character ~= c then return end
end
if refs[key] then return end
slotN=slotN + 1
r={char=c, hrp=hrp, pairs={}, conns={}, dirty=false, dirtyAt=0, isLocal=(key == SafeSvc.Players.LocalPlayer), npc=npc and true or false, mrad=6, slot=slotN, d=0, slow=clock() + rand() * SLOW_IV, cands={}, blk=false, step=1, upd=true, doOcc=false, hh=3, fyT=0}
refs[key]=r
mkDrt=function(v)
for _, cls in ipairs(watch) do
if v:IsA(cls) then
r.dirty=true
r.dirtyAt=clock() + DIRTY_DELAY
return
end
end
end
table.insert(r.conns, c.DescendantAdded:Connect(mkDrt))
table.insert(r.conns, c.DescendantRemoving:Connect(mkDrt))
bld(r)
end

function trk(plr)
if tracked[plr] then return end
tracked[plr]=true
plr.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(c)
task.wait(0.25)
addRef(plr, c)
end)
plr.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function() rmRef(plr) end)
if plr.Character then task.spawn(addRef, plr, plr.Character) end
end

function trkNpc(m)
if npcSet[m] or not m:IsA("Model") then return end
if SafeSvc.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then return end
npcSet[m]=true
end

function npcScan(cPos, have, near, root, d)
if not vpf then return end
cPos=SafeSvc.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame.Position
have=0
near={}
for m in pairs(npcSet) do
if not m.Parent or not m:IsDescendantOf(SafeSvc.Workspace) then
npcSet[m]=nil
if refs[m] then rmRef(m) end
elseif SafeSvc.Players:GetPlayerFromCharacter(m) then
npcSet[m]=nil
else
root=m:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or m.PrimaryPart
if root then
d=(root.Position - cPos).Magnitude
if refs[m] then
if d > NPC_DESPAWN then rmRef(m) else have=have + 1 end
elseif d < NPC_RANGE and not npcPending[m] then
near[#near + 1]={m, d}
end
end
end
end
for _ in pairs(npcPending) do have=have + 1 end
table.sort(near, function(x, y) return x[2] < y[2] end)
for i=1, #near do
if have >= NPC_MAX then break end
have=have + 1
npcPending[near[i][1]]=true
task.spawn(function(m)
pcall(addRef, m, m, true)
npcPending[m]=nil
end, near[i][1])
end
end

function stop()
if frameConn then frameConn:Disconnect() frameConn=nil end
pcall(function() SafeSvc.RunService:UnbindFromRenderStep("ReflectionStep") end)
for p in pairs(refs) do rmRef(p) end
if gui then gui:Destroy() gui, vpf, vcam=nil, nil, nil end
if pt then pt:Destroy() pt=nil end
end

function blk(q, s, l, tmin, tmax, d, t1, t2)
l=q.cf:PointToObjectSpace(s)
tmin, tmax=0, 1
d=l.X - q.o.X
if abs(d) < 1e-8 then
if abs(q.o.X) > q.hx then return false end
else
t1=(-q.hx - q.o.X) / d t2=(q.hx - q.o.X) / d
if t1 > t2 then t1, t2=t2, t1 end
if t1 > tmin then tmin=t1 end
if t2 < tmax then tmax=t2 end
if tmin > tmax then return false end
end
d=l.Y - q.o.Y
if abs(d) < 1e-8 then
if abs(q.o.Y) > q.hy then return false end
else
t1=(-q.hy - q.o.Y) / d t2=(q.hy - q.o.Y) / d
if t1 > t2 then t1, t2=t2, t1 end
if t1 > tmin then tmin=t1 end
if t2 < tmax then tmax=t2 end
if tmin > tmax then return false end
end
d=l.Z - q.o.Z
if abs(d) < 1e-8 then
if abs(q.o.Z) > q.hz then return false end
else
t1=(-q.hz - q.o.Z) / d t2=(q.hz - q.o.Z) / d
if t1 > t2 then t1, t2=t2, t1 end
if t1 > tmin then tmin=t1 end
if t2 < tmax then tmax=t2 end
if tmin > tmax then return false end
end
return tmin < 0.999
end

function detach(r)
if r.clone.Parent then r.clone.Parent=nil end
end

function collect(plr, r, now, cPos, lk, valid, hp, d, h, cBlk, fyC, p, acf)
r.blk=false
if r.npc then
valid=r.char.Parent ~= nil
else
valid=plr.Parent and plr.Character == r.char
end
if not valid or not r.char.Parent or not r.hrp.Parent then
rmRef(plr)
return
end
if r.dirty and now >= r.dirtyAt then
r.dirty=false
bld(r)
elseif now >= r.slow then
r.slow=now + SLOW_IV
sTick(r)
end
if not r.clone then return end
hp=r.hrp.Position
d=(hp - cPos).Magnitude
if d > CULL_DIST then detach(r) return end
-- floor height from math only, no raycast
h=r.hum
if h then
if not r.fy or (h.FloorMaterial ~= AIR and not AIR_STATE[h:GetState()]) then r.fy=hp.Y - r.hh end
elseif now >= r.fyT then
r.fyT=now + 0.1
r.fy=lowest(r) or r.fy
end
if not r.fy or cPos.Y <= r.fy then detach(r) return end
if r.clone.Parent ~= vpf then r.clone.Parent=vpf end
r.mc=V3(hp.X, 2 * r.fy - hp.Y, hp.Z)
r.d=d
r.c=hp
if (r.mc - cPos):Dot(lk) < -r.mrad then return end
cBlk=r.isLocal or d <= BLK_DIST
r.step=(cBlk or d < STEP2_DIST) and 1 or 2
r.upd=(r.step == 1) or (r.lfy == nil) or ((fr + r.slot) % r.step == 0)
r.doOcc=r.upd
if r.upd then
fyC=(r.fy ~= r.lfy)
for i=1, #r.pairs do
p=r.pairs[i]
if p[1].Parent then
acf=p[1].CFrame
if fyC or acf ~= p.lc then
p.lc=acf
p.mcf=mcf(acf, r.fy)
p[2].CFrame=p.mcf
end
if not p.root then
p.base=p[1].Transparency
p.vis=true
if cBlk and max(p.base, p[1].LocalTransparencyModifier) < 0.9 then
p.cf=acf
p.wp=acf.Position
p.o=acf:PointToObjectSpace(cPos)
p.rOn=true
else
p.rOn=false
end
end
else
p.vis=false
p.rOn=false
end
end
r.lfy=r.fy
if cBlk then
r.blk=true
nb=nb + 1
bl[nb]=r
end
end
nm=nm + 1
mir[nm]=r
end

function occ(r, cPos, nc, v, vv, o, w, t, dd, lm, p, v2, vv2, npc, q, nMn, hts, s, tg)
nc=0
v=r.mc - cPos
vv=v:Dot(v)
for k=1, nb do
o=bl[k]
w=o.c - cPos
t=vv > 1e-6 and w:Dot(v) / vv or 0
if t < 0 then t=0 elseif t > 1 then t=1 end
dd=v * t - w
lm=o.mrad + r.mrad
if dd:Dot(dd) < lm * lm then
nc=nc + 1
r.cands[nc]=o
end
end
for i=1, #r.pairs do
p=r.pairs[i]
if not p.root and p.vis then
tg=0
if nc > 0 then
v2=p.mcf.Position - cPos
vv2=v2:Dot(v2)
npc=0
for k=1, nc do
o=r.cands[k]
if not (p.own and o.isLocal) then
for m=1, #o.pairs do
q=o.pairs[m]
if q.rOn then
w=q.wp - cPos
t=vv2 > 1e-6 and w:Dot(v2) / vv2 or 0
if t < 0 then t=0 elseif t > 1 then t=1 end
dd=v2 * t - w
lm=q.qr + p.qr
if dd:Dot(dd) < lm * lm then
npc=npc + 1
pc[npc]=q
end
end
end
end
end
if npc > 0 then
for si=1, NOFFS do
s=p.mcf:PointToWorldSpace(OFFS[si] * p.sz)
for m=1, npc do
if blk(pc[m], s) then
tg=p.own and 0.35 or 0.95
break
end
end
if tg > 0 then break end
end
end
end
p.tg=tg
end
end
end

function fade(r, now, p, tr, f, tgt, s)
for i=1, #r.pairs do
p=r.pairs[i]
if not p.root then
if p.vis then
f, tgt=p.f, p.tg
s=min((now - (p.ft or now)) / FADE_T, 1)
p.ft=now
if f ~= tgt then
if f < tgt then
f=f + s
if f > tgt then f=tgt end
else
f=f - s
if f < tgt then f=tgt end
end
p.f=f
end
tr=p.base + (1 - p.base) * f
else
tr=1
end
if tr ~= p.wt then
p[2].Transparency=tr
p.wt=tr
end
end
end
end

function frame(dt, now, cam, vs, cCF, cPos, fov, fRad, h, lk, it, hd, al, j0, r)
fr=fr + 1
now=clock()
cam=SafeSvc.Workspace.CurrentCamera
if pt.Parent ~= cam then pt.Parent=cam end
vs=cam.ViewportSize
cCF=cam.CFrame
cPos=cCF.Position
fov=cam.FieldOfView
if vs ~= lVs or fov ~= lFov then
lVs, lFov=vs, fov
fRad=rad(fov)
h=2 * tan(fRad / 2) * 1.05
pt.Size=V3(h * (vs.X / vs.Y), h, 0.05)
gui.CanvasSize=vs
vcam.FieldOfView=min(120, deg(2 * atan(tan(fRad / 2) * 1.05)))
end
pt.CFrame=cCF * CF(0, 0, -(1 + 0.05 / 2))
vcam.CFrame=cCF
lk=cCF.LookVector
it=0.55 + (1 - 0.55) * clamp((-lk.Y - 0.35) / (0.75 - 0.35), 0, 1)
if it ~= lIT then vpf.ImageTransparency=it lIT=it end
hd=it >= 0.995
if hd == vis then vis=not hd vpf.Visible=vis end
if hd then return end
al=ALPHA_RATE > 0 and (1 - exp(-dt * ALPHA_RATE)) or 1
nm, nb=0, 0
for plr, rf in pairs(refs) do
collect(plr, rf, now, cPos, lk)
end
j0=nm > 0 and (fr % nm) or 0
for jj=1, nm do
r=mir[(jj + j0 - 1) % nm + 1]
if r.doOcc then occ(r, cPos) end
if r.upd then fade(r, now) end
end
end

pt=IN("Part")
pt.Name="ReflectionSurface"
pt.Anchored=true
pt.CanCollide=false
pt.CanTouch=false
pt.CanQuery=false
pt.CastShadow=false
pt.Transparency=1
pt.Size=V3(1, 1, 0.05)
pt.Parent=SafeSvc.Workspace.CurrentCamera

gui=IN("SurfaceGui")
gui.Name="Reflection"
gui.Adornee=pt
gui.Face=Enum.NormalId.Back
gui.AlwaysOnTop=true
gui.LightInfluence=0
gui.ResetOnSpawn=false
gui.ClipsDescendants=true
gui.SizingMode=Enum.SurfaceGuiSizingMode.FixedSize
gui.CanvasSize=SafeSvc.Workspace.CurrentCamera.ViewportSize
gui.Parent=gethui()

vpf=IN("ViewportFrame")
vpf.AnchorPoint=V2(0.5, 0.5)
vpf.Position=UD2(0.5, 0.5)
vpf.Size=UD2(1, 1)
vpf.BackgroundTransparency=1
vpf.BorderSizePixel=0
vpf.Ambient=C3(0.7, 0.7, 0.7)
vpf.LightColor=C3(1, 1, 1)
vpf.LightDirection=V3(0, 1, 0)
vpf.Parent=gui

vcam=IN("Camera")
vcam.Name="ReflectionCam"
vcam.CFrame=SafeSvc.Workspace.CurrentCamera.CFrame
vcam.FieldOfView=SafeSvc.Workspace.CurrentCamera.FieldOfView
vcam.Parent=vpf
vpf.CurrentCamera=vcam

local grd=IN("UIGradient")
grd.Transparency=NS({NSK(0, 0.2), NSK(0.6, 0.4), NSK(1, 0.8)})
grd.Rotation=90

scripts.code:
-- SpiderScript.lua
-- Cách dùng: Roblox Studio > ServerScriptService > Insert > Script, dán toàn bộ code này vào, bấm Play.
-- Thân nhện = "PalletLightBrown", 8 chân nhện (mỗi chân 2 đoạn) = "LadderLightBrown".
-- Nhện tự đi theo người chơi gần nhất, chân bước bằng IK nên bám được mặt đất gồ ghề.

local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local Players = game:GetService("Players")

---------------------------------------------------------------- CẤU HÌNH
local CONFIG = {
	SpawnPosition = Vector3.new(0, 15, 0),
	Color         = Color3.fromRGB(196, 164, 132), -- nâu nhạt
	BodySize      = Vector3.new(4, 2, 5),
	Speed         = 14,    -- studs/giây
	StopDistance  = 6,     -- dừng lại khi cách người chơi bao nhiêu studs
	TurnSpeed     = 6,
	BodyHeight    = 4.5,   -- độ cao thân so với mặt đất
	UpperLen      = 5,     -- đoạn chân trên
	LowerLen      = 6,     -- đoạn chân dưới
	LegThickness  = 0.7,
	StepDistance  = 3.5,   -- chân lệch quá mức này thì bước
	StepTime      = 0.18,
	StepHeight    = 1.8,
}
----------------------------------------------------------------

local spider = Instance.new("Model")
spider.Name = "Spider"

local function makePart(name, size, material)
	local p = Instance.new("Part")
	p.Name = name
	p.Size = size
	p.Color = CONFIG.Color
	p.Material = material
	p.Anchored = true
	p.CanCollide = false
	p.TopSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.BottomSurface = Enum.SurfaceType.Smooth
	p.Parent = spider
	return p
end

-- THÂN NHỆN
local body = makePart("PalletLightBrown", CONFIG.BodySize, Enum.Material.WoodPlanks)
body.CanCollide = true
body.CFrame = CFrame.new(CONFIG.SpawnPosition)
spider.PrimaryPart = body

local rayParams = RaycastParams.new()
rayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
rayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = { spider }

local function groundAt(pos)
	local r = workspace:Raycast(pos + Vector3.new(0, 15, 0), Vector3.new(0, -80, 0), rayParams)
	return r and r.Position or Vector3.new(pos.X, 0, pos.Z)
end

-- CHÂN NHỆN (4 chân mỗi bên)
local legs = {}
local zs = { -1.8, -0.6, 0.6, 1.8 }
for _, side in ipairs({ -1, 1 }) do
	for i, z in ipairs(zs) do
		local leg = {
			hip = Vector3.new(side * CONFIG.BodySize.X / 2, 0, z),
			rest = Vector3.new(side * 7, 0, z * 2.2),
			group = (i + (side == 1 and 0 or 1)) % 2, -- 2 nhóm chân bước xen kẽ
			upper = makePart("LadderLightBrown", Vector3.new(CONFIG.LegThickness, CONFIG.LegThickness, CONFIG.UpperLen), Enum.Material.Wood),
			lower = makePart("LadderLightBrown", Vector3.new(CONFIG.LegThickness, CONFIG.LegThickness, CONFIG.LowerLen), Enum.Material.Wood),
			stepping = false,
			t = 0,
		}
		leg.foot = groundAt(body.CFrame:PointToWorldSpace(leg.rest))
		table.insert(legs, leg)
	end
end

-- Giải IK 2 đoạn: trả về vị trí đầu gối và bàn chân thực tế
local function solveIK(hip, foot, l1, l2)
	local v = foot - hip
	local dir = v.Unit
	local d = math.clamp(v.Magnitude, math.abs(l1 - l2) + 0.1, l1 + l2 - 0.05)
	local a = (l1 * l1 - l2 * l2 + d * d) / (2 * d)
	local h = math.sqrt(math.max(l1 * l1 - a * a, 0))
	local up = Vector3.yAxis - dir * dir.Y
	up = up.Magnitude > 0.01 and up.Unit or Vector3.zAxis
	return hip + dir * a + up * h, hip + dir * d
end

local function placeSegment(part, a, b)
	local len = (b - a).Magnitude
	if len < 0.05 then return end
	part.Size = Vector3.new(CONFIG.LegThickness, CONFIG.LegThickness, len)
	part.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt((a + b) / 2, b)
end

local function otherGroupStepping(group)
	for _, l in ipairs(legs) do
		if l.group ~= group and l.stepping then return true end
	end
	return false
end

local function nearestTarget(pos)
	local best, bestDist
	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
		local hrp = plr.Character and plr.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
		if hrp then
			local d = (hrp.Position - pos).Magnitude
			if not bestDist or d < bestDist then best, bestDist = hrp.Position, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end

spider.Parent = workspace

RunService.Heartbeat:Connect(function(dt)
	local cf = body.CFrame
	local pos = cf.Position
	local moveDir = Vector3.zero

	-- Di chuyển + xoay về phía người chơi
	local target = nearestTarget(pos)
	if target then
		local flat = Vector3.new(target.X - pos.X, 0, target.Z - pos.Z)
		if flat.Magnitude > CONFIG.StopDistance then
			moveDir = flat.Unit
			pos = pos + moveDir * CONFIG.Speed * dt
			local look = CFrame.lookAt(pos, pos + moveDir).Rotation
			cf = CFrame.new(pos) * cf.Rotation:Lerp(look, math.min(1, dt * CONFIG.TurnSpeed))
		end
	end

	-- Giữ thân ở độ cao cố định so với mặt đất
	local g = groundAt(cf.Position)
	cf = CFrame.new(cf.X, g.Y + CONFIG.BodyHeight, cf.Z) * cf.Rotation
	body.CFrame = cf

	-- Cập nhật từng chân
	for _, l in ipairs(legs) do
		local hip = cf:PointToWorldSpace(l.hip)
		local restW = groundAt(cf:PointToWorldSpace(l.rest))

		if not l.stepping then
			local far = (restW - l.foot).Magnitude
			if (far > CONFIG.StepDistance and not otherGroupStepping(l.group)) or far > CONFIG.StepDistance * 2.5 then
				l.stepping = true
				l.t = 0
				l.from = l.foot
				l.to = restW + moveDir * 2
			end
		else
			l.t += dt / CONFIG.StepTime
			local a = math.min(l.t, 1)
			l.foot = l.from:Lerp(l.to, a) + Vector3.new(0, math.sin(a * math.pi) * CONFIG.StepHeight, 0)
			if l.t >= 1 then
				l.stepping = false
				l.foot = l.to
			end
		end

		local knee, foot = solveIK(hip, l.foot, CONFIG.UpperLen, CONFIG.LowerLen)
		placeSegment(l.upper, hip, knee)
		placeSegment(l.lower, knee, foot)
	end
end)

local function LFGQACR_fake_script() -- Frame.LocalScript 
	local script = Instance.new('LocalScript', Frame)

	local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
	local TweenService = game:GetService("TweenService")
	
	local gui = script.Parent -- Sürüklənəcək Frame
	
	local dragging
	local dragInput
	local dragStart
	local startPos
	
	local function update(input)
		local delta = input.Position - dragStart
		local endPosition = UDim2.new(startPos.X.Scale, startPos.X.Offset + delta.X, startPos.Y.Scale, startPos.Y.Offset + delta.Y)
	
		-- Hərəkətin daha hamar (smooth) görünməsi üçün TweenService istifadə edirik
		local tweenInfo = TweenInfo.new(0.1, Enum.EasingStyle.Quad, Enum.EasingDirection.Out)
		local tween = TweenService:Create(gui, tweenInfo, {Position = endPosition})
		tween:Play()
	end
	
	gui.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragging = true
			dragStart = input.Position
			startPos = gui.Position
	
			input.Changed:Connect(function()
				if input.UserInputState == Enum.UserInputState.End then
					dragging = false
				end
			end)
		end
	end)
	
	gui.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
			dragInput = input
		end
	end)
	
	UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
		if input == dragInput and dragging then
			update(input)
		end
	end)
	
end

					local cf = h.CFrame * CFrame.new(0, 1.5, 0)
	
					CreatePart(cf, workspace)
					task.wait(0.03)
	
					local part
	
					for _, v in ipairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
						if v:IsA("BasePart") and (v.Position - cf.p).Magnitude < 1 then
							part = v
							break
						end
					end
	
					if part then
						SetName(part, "particle")
	
						local id = ids[math.random(#ids)]
	
						SpawnDecal(part, Enum.NormalId.Front)
						AddDecal(part, id, Enum.NormalId.Front)
	
						SpawnDecal(part, Enum.NormalId.Back)
						AddDecal(part, id, Enum.NormalId.Back)
	
						SetTrans(part, 1)
						Resize(part, Vector3.new(3.5, 3.5, 0.2), part.CFrame)
						SetLocked(part, true)
						SetCollision(part, false)
	
						Weld(part, h, h)
	
						task.spawn(function()
							for i = 1, 16 do
								MovePart(part, part.CFrame + Vector3.new(0, 1, 0))
								task.wait(0.03)
							end
							DestroyPart(part)
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end)
end

scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UIS = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local CAS = game:GetService("ContextActionService")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

local Settings = {
    TOGGLE_KEY = Enum.KeyCode.L,
    TARGET_LIMBS = {"Head", "Right Arm"},
    LIMB_SIZE = 8,
    LIMB_TRANSPARENCY = 0.8,
    LIMB_CAN_COLLIDE = false,
    TEAM_CHECK = false,
    FORCEFIELD_CHECK = false,
    RESET_LIMB_ON_DEATH = false,
    USE_HIGHLIGHT = true,
    DEPTH_MODE = Enum.HighlightDepthMode.AlwaysOnTop,
    HIGHLIGHT_FILL_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(200, 20, 35),
    HIGHLIGHT_FILL_TRANSPARENCY = 0.85,
    HIGHLIGHT_OUTLINE_COLOR = Color3.fromRGB(255, 45, 65),
    HIGHLIGHT_OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY = 0,
}

-- All R6 & R15 Limbs
local ALL_LIMBS = {
    -- Common / R6
    "Head",
    "Torso",
    "Left Arm",
    "Right Arm",
    "Left Leg",
    "Right Leg",
    "HumanoidRootPart",
    -- R15 Torso
    "UpperTorso",
    "LowerTorso",
    -- R15 Left Arm
    "LeftUpperArm",
    "LeftLowerArm",
    "LeftHand",
    -- R15 Right Arm
    "RightUpperArm",
    "RightLowerArm",
    "RightHand",
    -- R15 Left Leg
    "LeftUpperLeg",
    "LeftLowerLeg",
    "LeftFoot",
    -- R15 Right Leg
    "RightUpperLeg",
    "RightLowerLeg",
    "RightFoot"
}

-- Global State Cleanup if re-executed
if getgenv and getgenv().LimbExtender and getgenv().LimbExtender.DestroyAll then
    getgenv().LimbExtender.DestroyAll()
end

local State = {
    Running = false,
    Destroyed = false,
    PlayerData = {},
    TouchConns = {},
    OriginalData = {}, -- Stores original Size, Transparency, CanCollide, CanTouch, Massless, MeshScale
    Connections = {},
    LimbButtons = {}
}

if getgenv then
    getgenv().LimbExtender = State
end

-- // Helper Functions \\ --

local function isTeammate(player)
    return Settings.TEAM_CHECK and LocalPlayer.Team ~= nil and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team
end

local function isLimbSelected(limbName)
    return table.find(Settings.TARGET_LIMBS, limbName) ~= nil
end

local function createHighlight(parent)
    if parent:FindFirstChild("LimbExtenderHighlight") then return end
    local h = Instance.new("Highlight")
    h.Name = "LimbExtenderHighlight"
    h.DepthMode = Settings.DEPTH_MODE
    h.FillColor = Settings.HIGHLIGHT_FILL_COLOR
    h.FillTransparency = Settings.HIGHLIGHT_FILL_TRANSPARENCY
    h.OutlineColor = Settings.HIGHLIGHT_OUTLINE_COLOR
    h.OutlineTransparency = Settings.HIGHLIGHT_OUTLINE_TRANSPARENCY
    h.Adornee = parent
    h.Parent = parent
    return h
end

local function removeHighlight(parent)
    if not parent then return end
    local h = parent:FindFirstChild("LimbExtenderHighlight")
    if h then h:Destroy() end
    -- Catch any stray highlights created
    for _, child in ipairs(parent:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("Highlight") then
            child:Destroy()
        end
    end
end

local function setNoTouch(limb)
    limb.CanTouch = false
    limb.CanCollide = Settings.LIMB_CAN_COLLIDE
    
    if State.TouchConns[limb] then
        State.TouchConns[limb]:Disconnect()
    end
    
    State.TouchConns[limb] = limb:GetPropertyChangedSignal("CanTouch"):Connect(function()
        if State.Running and not State.Destroyed and limb.CanTouch then
            limb.CanTouch = false
        end
    end)
end

local function saveOriginalProperties(limb)
    if State.OriginalData[limb] then return end
    local mesh = limb:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
    State.OriginalData[limb] = {
        Size = limb.Size,
        Transparency = limb.Transparency,
        CanCollide = limb.CanCollide,
        CanTouch = limb.CanTouch,
        Massless = limb.Massless,
        MeshScale = mesh and mesh.Scale or nil
    }
end

local function extendLimb(limb)
    if not limb or not limb:IsA("BasePart") then return end

    pcall(function()
        saveOriginalProperties(limb)

        limb.Size = Vector3.new(Settings.LIMB_SIZE, Settings.LIMB_SIZE, Settings.LIMB_SIZE)
        limb.Transparency = Settings.LIMB_TRANSPARENCY
        limb.CanCollide = Settings.LIMB_CAN_COLLIDE
        limb.CanTouch = false
        limb.Massless = true

        setNoTouch(limb)

        local mesh = limb:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
        if mesh then
            mesh.Scale = Vector3.new(1.25, 1.25, 1.25)
        end
    end)

    if Settings.USE_HIGHLIGHT then
        createHighlight(limb)
    else
        removeHighlight(limb)
    end
end

local function resetLimb(limb)
    if not limb then return end
    if State.TouchConns[limb] then
        State.TouchConns[limb]:Disconnect()
        State.TouchConns[limb] = nil
    end

    pcall(function()
        local orig = State.OriginalData[limb]
        if orig then
            limb.Size = orig.Size
            limb.Transparency = orig.Transparency
            limb.CanCollide = orig.CanCollide
            limb.CanTouch = orig.CanTouch
            limb.Massless = orig.Massless
            local mesh = limb:FindFirstChildOfClass("SpecialMesh")
            if mesh and orig.MeshScale then
                mesh.Scale = orig.MeshScale
            end
            State.OriginalData[limb] = nil
        else
            -- Fallback default sizes if original wasn't cached
            if limb.Name == "Head" then
                limb.Size = Vector3.new(2, 1, 1)
            elseif limb.Name == "HumanoidRootPart" or limb.Name == "Torso" or limb.Name == "UpperTorso" or limb.Name == "LowerTorso" then
                limb.Size = Vector3.new(2, 2, 1)
            else
                limb.Size = Vector3.new(1, 2, 1)
            end
            limb.Transparency = (limb.Name == "HumanoidRootPart") and 1 or 0
            limb.CanCollide = (limb.Name ~= "HumanoidRootPart")
            limb.CanTouch = true
            limb.Massless = false
        end
    end)

    removeHighlight(limb)
end

local function resetAllPlayers()
    -- Reset any limb stored in OriginalData
    for limb, _ in pairs(State.OriginalData) do
        if limb and limb.Parent then
            resetLimb(limb)
        end
    end
    State.OriginalData = {}

    -- Double-check all current player characters
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p.Character then
            for _, part in ipairs(p.Character:GetChildren()) do
                if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                    removeHighlight(part)
                    if isLimbSelected(part.Name) then
                        resetLimb(part)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function applyToCharacter(player, char)
    if not char or not State.Running or State.Destroyed then return end
    if isTeammate(player) then return end

    if Settings.FORCEFIELD_CHECK and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("ForceField") then
        local conn
        conn = char.ChildRemoved:Connect(function(c)
            if c:IsA("ForceField") then
                conn:Disconnect()
                applyToCharacter(player, char)
            end
        end)
        return
    end

    local humanoid = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
    if humanoid then
        for _, part in ipairs(char:GetChildren()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                if isLimbSelected(part.Name) then
                    extendLimb(part)
                    if Settings.RESET_LIMB_ON_DEATH then
                        humanoid.Died:Once(function()
                            resetLimb(part)
                        end)
                    end
                else
                    -- Reset if deselected while running
                    if State.OriginalData[part] then
                        resetLimb(part)
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
end

local function refreshAllCharacters()
    if not State.Running then return end
    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character then
            applyToCharacter(p, p.Character)
        end
    end
end

local function onPlayerAdded(player)
    if player == LocalPlayer then return end
    if State.PlayerData[player] then
        State.PlayerData[player]:Disconnect()
    end
    State.PlayerData[player] = player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        task.wait(0.25)
        if State.Running and not State.Destroyed then
            applyToCharacter(player, char)
        end
    end)
    if player.Character then
        task.defer(applyToCharacter, player, player.Character)
    end
end

local function onPlayerRemoving(player)
    if State.PlayerData[player] then
        State.PlayerData[player]:Disconnect()
        State.PlayerData[player] = nil
    end
end

local UpdateToggleVisuals -- Forward declaration

local function start()
    if State.Destroyed or State.Running then return end
    State.Running = true

    State.SteppedConn = RunService.Stepped:Connect(function()
        if not State.Running or State.Destroyed then return end
        for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
            if p ~= LocalPlayer and p.Character and not isTeammate(p) then
                for _, limbName in ipairs(Settings.TARGET_LIMBS) do
                    local limb = p.Character:FindFirstChild(limbName)
                    if limb and limb:IsA("BasePart") then
                        limb.CanTouch = false
                        limb.CanCollide = Settings.LIMB_CAN_COLLIDE
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end)

    for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if p ~= LocalPlayer then
            onPlayerAdded(p)
        end
    end

    State.AddConn = Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(onPlayerAdded)
    State.RemConn = Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(onPlayerRemoving)

    if UpdateToggleVisuals then UpdateToggleVisuals() end
end

local function stop()
    if not State.Running then return end
    State.Running = false

    if State.SteppedConn then
        State.SteppedConn:Disconnect()
        State.SteppedConn = nil
    end
    for _, conn in pairs(State.PlayerData) do
        if typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then conn:Disconnect() end
    end
    State.PlayerData = {}

    if State.AddConn then State.AddConn:Disconnect() State.AddConn = nil end
    if State.RemConn then State.RemConn:Disconnect() State.RemConn = nil end

    resetAllPlayers()
    if UpdateToggleVisuals then UpdateToggleVisuals() end
end

local function toggle()
    if State.Destroyed then return end
    if State.Running then
        stop()
    else
        start()
    end
end

        end)

end)

            startPos.Y.Scale,

end))

    if State.Destroyed then return end

    State.Destroyed = true

    -- Disconnect all Touch connections
    for limb, conn in pairs(State.TouchConns) do
        if typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    State.TouchConns = {}

    -- Disconnect all UI / Input connections
    for _, conn in ipairs(State.Connections) do
        if typeof(conn) == "RBXScriptConnection" then
            conn:Disconnect()
        end
    end
    State.Connections = {}

    -- Unbind mobile action
    pcall(function()
        CAS:UnbindAction("LimbExtenderToggle")
    end)

    -- Reset all limbs & destroy highlights one final time
    resetAllPlayers()

    -- Destroy UI
    if ScreenGui then
        ScreenGui:Destroy()
    end

    if getgenv then
        getgenv().LimbExtender = nil
    end
end

    if input.KeyCode == Settings.TOGGLE_KEY then

        ScreenGui.Enabled = not ScreenGui.Enabled
    end
end))

end, true, Settings.TOGGLE_KEY)
