local cloneref = (typeof(cloneref) == "function" and cloneref) or function(o) return o end
local Players = cloneref(game:GetService("Players"))
local UserInputService = cloneref(game:GetService("UserInputService"))
local RunService = cloneref(game:GetService("RunService"))
local CoreGui = cloneref(game:GetService("CoreGui"))
local GuiService = cloneref(game:GetService("GuiService"))
local Workspace = cloneref(game:GetService("Workspace"))
local Lighting = cloneref(game:GetService("Lighting"))
local ReplicatedStorage = cloneref(game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"))
local TeleportService = cloneref(game:GetService("TeleportService"))
local HttpService = cloneref(game:GetService("HttpService"))
local VirtualUser = cloneref(game:GetService("VirtualUser"))

local lp = Players.LocalPlayer
while not lp do
	Players:GetPropertyChangedSignal("LocalPlayer"):Wait()
	lp = Players.LocalPlayer
end

local cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
local mouse = lp:GetMouse()
local alive = true

local function getPointer()
	local m = UserInputService:GetMouseLocation()
	local ok, inset = pcall(function() return GuiService:GetGuiInset() end)
	if ok and inset then m = m - inset end
	return m
end

local function resolveGuiParent()
	if typeof(gethui) == "function" then
		local ok, holder = pcall(gethui)
		if ok and typeof(holder) == "Instance" then return holder end
	end
	local ok = pcall(function()
		local probe = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
		probe.Parent = CoreGui
		probe:Destroy()
	end)
	if ok then return CoreGui end
	return lp:WaitForChild("PlayerGui")
end

local GUI_PARENT = resolveGuiParent()
local GUI_NAME = "SkidWare_UI"
local OVERLAY_NAME = "SkidWare_Overlay"

for _, old in ipairs(GUI_PARENT:GetChildren()) do
	if old.Name == GUI_NAME or old.Name == OVERLAY_NAME then
		old:Destroy()
	end
end

	red = Color3.fromRGB(225, 75, 85),

local themeBindings = {}
local function bindTheme(obj, prop, key, condFn)
	table.insert(themeBindings, {obj = obj, prop = prop, key = key, cond = condFn})
end

local function create(class, props)
	local o = Instance.new(class)
	if o:IsA("GuiObject") then
		o.BorderSizePixel = 0
	end
	pcall(function() o.AutoLocalize = false end)
	local parent = props.Parent
	for k, v in pairs(props) do
		if k ~= "Parent" then
			o[k] = v
		end
	end
	if parent then
		o.Parent = parent
	end
	return o
end

local function inset(frame)
	frame.BorderMode = Enum.BorderMode.Inset
	frame.BorderSizePixel = 1
	frame.BorderColor3 = Color3.new(0, 0, 0)
	return frame
end

	cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera

	local sx = (vp.X - 24) / 660
	local sy = (vp.Y - 24) / 420
	uiScale.Scale = math.clamp(math.min(sx, sy, 1), 0.45, 1.25)

do
	local dragging = false
	local dragStart, startPos
	topBar.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
		if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then

local tabs = {}
local pages = {}
local tabCount = 0
local activeTabName = "Player"

local function selectTab(name)
	activeTabName = name
	for tName, page in pairs(pages) do
		page.Visible = (tName == name)
	end
	for tName, btn in pairs(tabs) do
		btn.TextColor3 = (tName == name) and Theme.scheme or Theme.text2
		btn.BackgroundColor3 = (tName == name) and Theme.bg4 or Theme.bg3
	end
end

local function createTab(name)
	tabCount += 1
	local idx = tabCount
	local btn = create("TextButton", {
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(8, 8 + (idx - 1) * 34),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(116, 28),
		BackgroundColor3 = Theme.bg3,
		Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
		Text = name,
		TextColor3 = Theme.text2,
		TextSize = 13,
		AutoButtonColor = false,
		Parent = sidebar,
	})
	inset(btn)
	bindTheme(btn, "TextColor3", "scheme", function() return activeTabName == name end)
	bindTheme(btn, "TextColor3", "text2", function() return activeTabName ~= name end)
	bindTheme(btn, "BackgroundColor3", "bg4", function() return activeTabName == name end)
	bindTheme(btn, "BackgroundColor3", "bg3", function() return activeTabName ~= name end)

	local page = create("Frame", {
		Visible = false,
		BackgroundTransparency = 1,
		Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 0),
		Size = UDim2.fromOffset(506, 370),
		Parent = contentArea,
	})

	local function makeCol(xPos)
		local col = inset(create("ScrollingFrame", {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(xPos, 8),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(241, 354),
			BackgroundColor3 = Theme.bg,
			ScrollBarThickness = 4,
			ScrollBarImageColor3 = Theme.scheme,
			CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, 1200),
			ClipsDescendants = true,
			Parent = page,
		}))
		bindTheme(col, "BackgroundColor3", "bg")
		bindTheme(col, "ScrollBarImageColor3", "scheme")

		local holder = create("Frame", {
			Name = "Holder",
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(6, 6),
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(229, 1200),
			Parent = col,
		})

		local yCursor = 0
		local function addWidget(h)
			local y = yCursor
			yCursor += h + 6
			col.CanvasSize = UDim2.fromOffset(0, math.max(354, yCursor + 12))
			holder.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(229, yCursor)
			return y
		end

		return holder, addWidget
	end

	local leftHolder, leftAdd = makeCol(8)
	local rightHolder, rightAdd = makeCol(257)

	tabs[name] = btn
	pages[name] = page

	btn.Activated:Connect(function()
		selectTab(name)
	end)

	local api = {}
	function api:Section(title, side)
		local parentHolder = (side == "Right") and rightHolder or leftHolder
		local addY = (side == "Right") and rightAdd or leftAdd

		local secHeader = create("TextLabel", {
			Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, addY(18)),
			BackgroundTransparency = 1,
			Size = UDim2.fromOffset(229, 18),
			Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
			Text = string.upper(tostring(title or "SECTION")),
			TextColor3 = Theme.scheme,
			TextSize = 11,
			TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
			Parent = parentHolder,
		})
		bindTheme(secHeader, "TextColor3", "scheme")

		local secApi = {}

		function secApi:Toggle(text, default, cb)
			local state = default and true or false
			local row = create("TextButton", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, addY(26)),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(229, 26),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.bg3,
				Text = "",
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Parent = parentHolder,
			})
			inset(row)
			bindTheme(row, "BackgroundColor3", "bg3")

			local box = create("Frame", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 7),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(12, 12),
				BackgroundColor3 = state and Theme.scheme or Theme.bg4,
				Parent = row,
			})
			inset(box)
			bindTheme(box, "BackgroundColor3", "scheme", function() return state end)
			bindTheme(box, "BackgroundColor3", "bg4", function() return not state end)

			local lbl = create("TextLabel", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(25, 0),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(198, 26),
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
				Text = text,
				TextColor3 = state and Theme.text or Theme.text2,
				TextSize = 12,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				Parent = row,
			})
			bindTheme(lbl, "TextColor3", "text", function() return state end)
			bindTheme(lbl, "TextColor3", "text2", function() return not state end)

			row.Activated:Connect(function()
				state = not state
				box.BackgroundColor3 = state and Theme.scheme or Theme.bg4
				lbl.TextColor3 = state and Theme.text or Theme.text2
				if cb then cb(state) end
			end)
		end

		function secApi:Slider(text, minVal, maxVal, defaultVal, cb)
			local val = defaultVal or minVal
			local sliding = false

			local holder = create("Frame", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, addY(36)),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(229, 36),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.bg3,
				Parent = parentHolder,
			})
			inset(holder)
			bindTheme(holder, "BackgroundColor3", "bg3")

			local topLbl = create("TextLabel", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 3),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(215, 14),
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
				Text = string.format("%s: %d", text, val),
				TextColor3 = Theme.text2,
				TextSize = 11,
				TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left,
				Parent = holder,
			})
			bindTheme(topLbl, "TextColor3", "text2")

			local track = create("Frame", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(7, 21),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(215, 9),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.bg4,
				Parent = holder,
			})
			inset(track)
			bindTheme(track, "BackgroundColor3", "bg4")

			local span = math.max(1e-6, maxVal - minVal)
			local ratio = math.clamp((val - minVal) / span, 0, 1)
			local fill = create("Frame", {
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(215 * ratio), 9),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.scheme,
				Parent = track,
			})
			bindTheme(fill, "BackgroundColor3", "scheme")

			local hit = create("TextButton", {
				BackgroundTransparency = 1,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(215, 18),
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, -4),
				Text = "",
				Parent = track,
			})

			local function setFromX(x)
				local r = math.clamp((x - track.AbsolutePosition.X) / math.max(1, track.AbsoluteSize.X), 0, 1)
				val = math.floor(minVal + (maxVal - minVal) * r + 0.5)
				fill.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.floor(215 * r), 9)
				topLbl.Text = string.format("%s: %d", text, val)
				if cb then cb(val) end
			end

			hit.InputBegan:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					sliding = true
					setFromX(getPointer().X)
				end
			end)
			UserInputService.InputChanged:Connect(function(input)
				if sliding and (input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseMovement or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch) then
					setFromX(getPointer().X)
				end
			end)
			UserInputService.InputEnded:Connect(function(input)
				if input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1 or input.UserInputType == Enum.UserInputType.Touch then
					sliding = false
				end
			end)
		end

		function secApi:Selector(text, options, defaultIndex, cb)
			local idx = defaultIndex or 1
			local btn = create("TextButton", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, addY(26)),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(229, 26),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.bg3,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamMedium,
				Text = string.format("%s: %s", text, tostring(options[idx])),
				TextColor3 = Theme.text,
				TextSize = 12,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Parent = parentHolder,
			})
			inset(btn)
			bindTheme(btn, "BackgroundColor3", "bg3")
			bindTheme(btn, "TextColor3", "text")

			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				idx = (idx % #options) + 1
				btn.Text = string.format("%s: %s", text, tostring(options[idx]))
				if cb then cb(options[idx]) end
			end)

			return {
				setOptions = function(newOpts, newIdx)
					options = (#newOpts > 0) and newOpts or {"None"}
					idx = math.clamp(newIdx or 1, 1, #options)
					btn.Text = string.format("%s: %s", text, tostring(options[idx]))
				end,
				getCurrent = function()
					return options[idx]
				end,
			}
		end

		function secApi:Button(text, cb)
			local btn = create("TextButton", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, addY(26)),
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(229, 26),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.bg4,
				Font = Enum.Font.GothamBold,
				Text = text,
				TextColor3 = Theme.text,
				TextSize = 12,
				AutoButtonColor = false,
				Parent = parentHolder,
			})
			inset(btn)
			bindTheme(btn, "BackgroundColor3", "bg4")
			bindTheme(btn, "TextColor3", "text")

			btn.Activated:Connect(function()
				if cb then cb() end
			end)
			return btn
		end

		function secApi:Label(text)
			local lbl = create("TextLabel", {
				Position = UDim2.fromOffset(0, addY(24)),
				BackgroundColor3 = Theme.bg3,
				Size = UDim2.fromOffset(229, 24),
				Font = Enum.Font.Code,
				Text = text,
				TextColor3 = Theme.text2,
				TextSize = 11,
				Parent = parentHolder,
			})
			inset(lbl)
			bindTheme(lbl, "BackgroundColor3", "bg3")
			bindTheme(lbl, "TextColor3", "text2")
			return lbl
		end

		return secApi
	end

	return api
end

local function applyThemePreset(presetName)
	local p = ThemePresets[presetName]
	if not p then return end
	Theme.scheme = p.scheme
	Theme.bg = p.bg
	Theme.bg2 = p.bg2
	Theme.bg3 = p.bg3
	Theme.bg4 = p.bg4
	Theme.text = p.text
	Theme.text2 = p.text2
	for _, b in ipairs(themeBindings) do
		if b.obj and b.obj.Parent then
			if not b.cond or b.cond() then
				b.obj[b.prop] = Theme[b.key]
			end
		end
	end
end

local function buildRigCache(model)
	local hum = model:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = model:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") or model.PrimaryPart
	if not hum or not root then return nil end
	local head = model:FindFirstChild("Head") or root
	local torso = model:FindFirstChild("UpperTorso") or model:FindFirstChild("Torso") or root
	local joints = {}
	for _, pair in ipairs(JOINT_NAMES) do
		local pA = model:FindFirstChild(pair[1])
		local pB = model:FindFirstChild(pair[2])
		if pA and pB and pA:IsA("BasePart") and pB:IsA("BasePart") then
			table.insert(joints, {pA, pB})
		end
	end
	return {
		model = model,
		hum = hum,
		root = root,
		head = head,
		torso = torso,
		joints = joints,
	}
end

local function registerPotentialNpc(model)
	if not model or not model:IsA("Model") then return end
	if playerCharLookup[model] then return end
	if cachedNpcModels[model] then return end
	local data = buildRigCache(model)
	if data then
		cachedNpcModels[model] = data
	end
end

local function rebuildTargetCaches()
	table.clear(playerCharLookup)

	for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do

	for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do

local sharedRayParams = RaycastParams.new()
sharedRayParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Exclude
local rayIgnoreList = {}

local function isPartVisible(fromPos, targetPart)
	if not cfg.wallCheckEnabled then return true end
	table.clear(rayIgnoreList)
	if cam then table.insert(rayIgnoreList, cam) end
	if lp.Character then table.insert(rayIgnoreList, lp.Character) end
	if targetPart and targetPart.Parent then table.insert(rayIgnoreList, targetPart.Parent) end
	sharedRayParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = rayIgnoreList
	local res = Workspace:Raycast(fromPos, targetPart.Position - fromPos, sharedRayParams)
	return res == nil
end

local function getTargets(includeNpcs, includePlayers)
	local list = {}

	if includePlayers then
		for _, plr in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
			if plr ~= lp and not isTeammate(plr) then
				local char = plr.Character
				if char then
					local cached = playerRigCache[char]
					if not cached or not cached.root or not cached.root.Parent then
						cached = buildRigCache(char)
						playerRigCache[char] = cached
					end
					if cached and cached.hum and cached.hum.Health > 0 and cached.root and cached.root.Parent then
						table.insert(list, {
							model = char,
							hum = cached.hum,
							root = cached.root,
							head = cached.head,
							torso = cached.torso,
							joints = cached.joints,
							isPlayer = true,
							label = plr.DisplayName or plr.Name,
						})
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	if includeNpcs then
		for model, data in pairs(cachedNpcModels) do
			if not model.Parent or playerCharLookup[model] then
				cachedNpcModels[model] = nil
			elseif data.hum and data.hum.Health > 0 and data.root and data.root.Parent then
				table.insert(list, {
					model = model,
					hum = data.hum,
					root = data.root,
					head = data.head,
					torso = data.torso,
					joints = data.joints,
					isPlayer = false,
					label = model.Name,
				})
			end
		end
	end

	return list
end

local function getAimPartFromTarget(t)
	if cfg.aimPart == "Head" then
		return t.head or t.root
	elseif cfg.aimPart == "Root" then
		return t.root
	elseif cfg.aimPart == "Torso" then
		return t.torso or t.root
	end
	return t.head or t.root
end

local function getClosestTarget(maxFov)
	cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return nil end
	local center = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X * 0.5, cam.ViewportSize.Y * 0.5)
	local bestPart = nil
	local bestDist = maxFov

	for _, t in ipairs(getTargets(cfg.targetNpcs, cfg.targetPlayers)) do
		local part = getAimPartFromTarget(t)
		if part then
			local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
			if onScreen and sp.Z > 0 then
				local d = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
				if d < bestDist and isPartVisible(cam.CFrame.Position, part) then
					bestDist = d
					bestPart = part
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestPart
end

local function getTargetInTriggerZone(useBox, halfBoxPx, maxFov)
	cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then return nil end
	local center = Vector2.new(cam.ViewportSize.X * 0.5, cam.ViewportSize.Y * 0.5)
	local bestPart = nil
	local bestDist = useBox and math.huge or maxFov

	for _, t in ipairs(getTargets(cfg.targetNpcs, cfg.targetPlayers)) do
		local part = getAimPartFromTarget(t)
		if part and part:IsA("BasePart") then
			local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
			if onScreen and sp.Z > 0 then
				local dx = math.abs(sp.X - center.X)
				local dy = math.abs(sp.Y - center.Y)
				local dist = (Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y) - center).Magnitude
				local inside = useBox and (dx <= halfBoxPx and dy <= halfBoxPx) or (dist <= maxFov)
				if inside and dist < bestDist and isPartVisible(cam.CFrame.Position, part) then
					bestDist = dist
					bestPart = part
				end
			end
		end
	end

	return bestPart
end

local function fireEquippedGun(targetPart)
	local char = lp.Character
	if not char then return end
	local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	if not tool then return end

	if targetPart and targetPart:IsA("BasePart") and cfg.silentAimEnabled and cfg.silentAimSnapCam and cam then
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position)
	end

	pcall(function()
		tool:Activate()
	end)

	pcall(function()
		if mouse and mouse.Button1Down then
			mouse.Button1Down:Fire()
		end
	end)

	local containers = {tool, char, ReplicatedStorage}
	for _, rootObj in ipairs(containers) do
		for _, desc in ipairs(rootObj:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("RemoteEvent") then
				local lower = string.lower(desc.Name)
				if string.find(lower, "fire") or string.find(lower, "shoot") or string.find(lower, "gun") or string.find(lower, "hit") or string.find(lower, "damage") or string.find(lower, "attack") then
					local hitPos = (targetPart and targetPart.Position) or (mouse and mouse.Hit and mouse.Hit.Position)
					if hitPos then
						pcall(function()
							desc:FireServer(hitPos, targetPart)
						end)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function clearGunCooldowns()
	local char = lp.Character
	if not char then return end
	local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
	local targets = {char}
	if tool then table.insert(targets, tool) end

	for _, rootObj in ipairs(targets) do
		for _, desc in ipairs(rootObj:GetDescendants()) do
			if desc:IsA("NumberValue") or desc:IsA("IntValue") then
				local n = string.lower(desc.Name)
				if string.find(n, "cooldown") or string.find(n, "cd") or string.find(n, "debounce") or string.find(n, "reload") or string.find(n, "firerate") or string.find(n, "delay") then
					desc.Value = 0
				end
			elseif desc:IsA("BoolValue") then
				local n = string.lower(desc.Name)
				if string.find(n, "cooldown") or string.find(n, "debounce") or string.find(n, "reload") or string.find(n, "equip") or string.find(n, "busy") then
					desc.Value = false
				end
			end
		end
		for attrName in pairs(rootObj:GetAttributes()) do
			local n = string.lower(attrName)
			if string.find(n, "cooldown") or string.find(n, "cd") or string.find(n, "debounce") or string.find(n, "reload") or string.find(n, "delay") then
				rootObj:SetAttribute(attrName, 0)
			end
		end
	end
end

local fpsConn = nil
local function optimizeInstance(obj)
	if not cfg.fpsBoostActive then return end
	if cfg.fpsSmoothMaterials and obj:IsA("BasePart") then
		obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
		obj.Reflectance = 0
		if cfg.fpsNoShadows then
			obj.CastShadow = false
		end
	elseif cfg.fpsDisableParticles then
		if obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") or obj:IsA("Trail") or obj:IsA("Smoke") or obj:IsA("Fire") or obj:IsA("Sparkles") then
			obj.Enabled = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Beam") then
			obj.Enabled = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Decal") or obj:IsA("Texture") then
			obj.Transparency = 1
		end
	end
end

local function applyFpsBooster(enable)
	cfg.fpsBoostActive = enable
	if enable then
		if cfg.fpsNoShadows then
			Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
			Lighting.FogEnd = 9e9
		end
		for _, eff in ipairs(Lighting:GetChildren()) do
			if eff:IsA("PostEffect") then
				eff.Enabled = false
			end
		end
		local terrain = Workspace:FindFirstChildOfClass("Terrain")
		if terrain then
			terrain.WaterWaveSize = 0
			terrain.WaterWaveSpeed = 0
			terrain.WaterReflectance = 0
			terrain.WaterTransparency = 0
			pcall(function()
				terrain.Decoration = false
			end)
		end
		pcall(function()
			settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Level01
		end)
		for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			optimizeInstance(obj)
		end
		if not fpsConn then
			fpsConn = Workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(function(obj)
				if cfg.fpsBoostActive then
					optimizeInstance(obj)
				end
			end)
		end
	else
		Lighting.GlobalShadows = true
		pcall(function()
			settings().Rendering.QualityLevel = Enum.QualityLevel.Automatic
		end)
	end
end

local xraySaved = {}
local function applyXray(enable)
	cfg.xrayEnabled = enable
	if enable then
		for _, obj in ipairs(Workspace:GetDescendants()) do
			if obj:IsA("BasePart") and not obj:IsDescendantOf(lp.Character or Workspace) and obj.Transparency < 0.5 then
				local parentMdl = obj:FindFirstAncestorOfClass("Model")

		end

local function serverHop(smallestFirst, statusLabel)
	if statusLabel then statusLabel.Text = "Scanning servers..." end
	task.spawn(function()
		local sortOrder = smallestFirst and "Asc" or "Desc"
		local url = string.format("https://games.roblox.com/v1/games/%d/servers/Public?sortOrder=%s&limit=100", game.PlaceId, sortOrder)
		local ok, raw = pcall(function()
			return game:HttpGet(url)
		end)
		if ok and raw then
			local decOk, data = pcall(function()
				return HttpService:JSONDecode(raw)
			end)
			if decOk and data and data.data then
				local candidates = {}
				for _, srv in ipairs(data.data) do
					if srv.id and srv.id ~= game.JobId and srv.playing and srv.maxPlayers and srv.playing < srv.maxPlayers then
						table.insert(candidates, srv.id)
					end
				end
				if #candidates > 0 then
					local chosen = smallestFirst and candidates[1] or candidates[math.random(1, #candidates)]
					if statusLabel then statusLabel.Text = "Hopping server..." end
					TeleportService:TeleportToPlaceInstance(game.PlaceId, chosen, lp)
					return
				end
			end
		end
		if statusLabel then statusLabel.Text = "Fallback teleport..." end
		TeleportService:Teleport(game.PlaceId, lp)
	end)
end

local function beginLineBatch()
	prevLineUsed = lineUsed

local function endLineBatch()
	for i = lineUsed + 1, prevLineUsed do
		local fr = linePool[i]
		if fr then fr.Visible = false end
	end

local function drawLine2D(p1, p2, thickness, color, transparency)
	lineUsed += 1
	local fr = linePool[lineUsed]
	if not fr then
		fr = Instance.new("Frame")
		fr.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
		fr.BorderSizePixel = 0
		fr.Parent = overlayGui
		linePool[lineUsed] = fr
	end
	local delta = p2 - p1
	local len = delta.Magnitude
	fr.Visible = true
	fr.BackgroundColor3 = color
	fr.BackgroundTransparency = transparency or 0.15
	fr.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(math.max(1, len), thickness or 2)
	fr.Position = UDim2.fromOffset((p1.X + p2.X) * 0.5, (p1.Y + p2.Y) * 0.5)
	fr.Rotation = math.deg(math.atan2(delta.Y, delta.X))
end

local function drawCornerBox2D(minX, minY, maxX, maxY, color)
	local w = maxX - minX
	local h = maxY - minY
	if w < 4 or h < 4 then return end
	local cw = math.min(12, w * 0.25)
	local ch = math.min(14, h * 0.25)

	local tl = Vector2.new(minX, minY)
	local tr = Vector2.new(maxX, minY)
	local bl = Vector2.new(minX, maxY)
	local br = Vector2.new(maxX, maxY)

	drawLine2D(tl, tl + Vector2.new(cw, 0), 1.5, color, 0.1)
	drawLine2D(tl, tl + Vector2.new(0, ch), 1.5, color, 0.1)
	drawLine2D(tr, tr + Vector2.new(-cw, 0), 1.5, color, 0.1)
	drawLine2D(tr, tr + Vector2.new(0, ch), 1.5, color, 0.1)
	drawLine2D(bl, bl + Vector2.new(cw, 0), 1.5, color, 0.1)
	drawLine2D(bl, bl + Vector2.new(0, -ch), 1.5, color, 0.1)
	drawLine2D(br, br + Vector2.new(-cw, 0), 1.5, color, 0.1)
	drawLine2D(br, br + Vector2.new(0, -ch), 1.5, color, 0.1)
end

local BOX_EDGES = {
	{1, 2}, {2, 3}, {3, 4}, {4, 1},
	{5, 6}, {6, 7}, {7, 8}, {8, 5},
	{1, 5}, {2, 6}, {3, 7}, {4, 8},

local function projectBoundsAnd3DBox(cf, size, color, draw3D)
	local hx, hy, hz = size.X * 0.5, size.Y * 0.5, size.Z * 0.5
	local corners3D = {
		cf * Vector3.new(-hx, -hy, -hz),
		cf * Vector3.new(hx, -hy, -hz),
		cf * Vector3.new(hx, hy, -hz),
		cf * Vector3.new(-hx, hy, -hz),
		cf * Vector3.new(-hx, -hy, hz),
		cf * Vector3.new(hx, -hy, hz),
		cf * Vector3.new(hx, hy, hz),
		cf * Vector3.new(-hx, hy, hz),
	}
	local pts = {}
	local minX, minY = math.huge, math.huge
	local maxX, maxY = -math.huge, -math.huge
	for i = 1, 8 do
		local sp, ok = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(corners3D[i])
		if not ok or sp.Z <= 0 then return nil end
		pts[i] = Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y)
		if sp.X < minX then minX = sp.X end
		if sp.Y < minY then minY = sp.Y end
		if sp.X > maxX then maxX = sp.X end
		if sp.Y > maxY then maxY = sp.Y end
	end
	if draw3D then
		for _, e in ipairs(BOX_EDGES) do
			drawLine2D(pts[e[1]], pts[e[2]], 1.5, color, 0.25)
		end
	end
	return minX, minY, maxX, maxY
end

local function drawSkeletonCached(joints, color)

			local sB, okB = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(pB.Position)

				drawLine2D(Vector2.new(sA.X, sA.Y), Vector2.new(sB.X, sB.Y), 1.5, color, 0.2)
			end
		end
	end
end

	hpFill.Parent = hpBg

	local headDot = nil
	if target.head and target.head:IsA("BasePart") then
		headDot = Instance.new("BillboardGui")
		headDot.Adornee = target.head
		headDot.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(10, 10)
		headDot.AlwaysOnTop = true
		headDot.Parent = espFolder

		local dot = Instance.new("Frame")
		dot.Size = UDim2.fromScale(1, 1)
		dot.BackgroundColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
		dot.BorderSizePixel = 0
		dot.Parent = headDot
		Instance.new("UICorner", dot).CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
	end

	local objs = {hl, bb}
	if headDot then table.insert(objs, headDot) end

	local entry = {
		model = target.model,
		hl = hl,
		bb = bb,
		lbl = lbl,
		hpBg = hpBg,
		hpFill = hpFill,
		headDot = headDot,
		objs = objs,
		lastHp = -1,
		lastDist = -1,
	}
	espEntries[target.model] = entry
	return entry
end

local function updateEsp()
	beginLineBatch()
	cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	if not cam then
		endLineBatch()
		return
	end
	local active = {}
	local origin = (lp.Character and lp.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart") and lp.Character.HumanoidRootPart.Position) or cam.CFrame.Position
	local vpSize = cam.ViewportSize
	local bottomCenter = Vector2.new(vpSize.X * 0.5, vpSize.Y)
	local need2DBox = cfg.espBox3D or cfg.espCornerBox

	fovRing.Visible = cfg.showFovCircle and (cfg.aimbotEnabled or cfg.silentAimEnabled)
	if fovRing.Visible then
		local diam = (cfg.aimbotEnabled and cfg.aimbotFov or cfg.silentAimFov) * 2
		fovRing.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(diam, diam)
	end

	triggerBoxFrame.Visible = cfg.triggerBoxEnabled
	if triggerBoxFrame.Visible then
		local side = cfg.triggerBoxSize * 2
		triggerBoxFrame.Size = UDim2.fromOffset(side, side)
	end

	if cfg.npcEspEnabled or cfg.playerEspEnabled then
		for _, t in ipairs(getTargets(cfg.npcEspEnabled, cfg.playerEspEnabled)) do
			local dist = (t.root.Position - origin).Magnitude
			if dist <= cfg.espMaxDist then
				active[t.model] = true
				local entry = getOrCreateEsp(t)
				local col = t.isPlayer and cfg.playerEspColor or cfg.npcEspColor

				if entry.hl.Enabled ~= cfg.espHighlight then
					entry.hl.Enabled = cfg.espHighlight
				end
				if cfg.espHighlight then
					entry.hl.FillColor = col
					entry.hl.OutlineColor = Color3.new(1, 1, 1)
				end

				if entry.headDot and entry.headDot.Enabled ~= cfg.espHeadDot then
					entry.headDot.Enabled = cfg.espHeadDot
				end

				local showBb = cfg.espInfo or cfg.espHpBar
				if entry.bb.Enabled ~= showBb then
					entry.bb.Enabled = showBb
				end
				if showBb then
					entry.lbl.Visible = cfg.espInfo
					entry.hpBg.Visible = cfg.espHpBar
					local hpInt = math.floor(t.hum.Health)
					local distInt = math.floor(dist)
					if cfg.espInfo and (hpInt ~= entry.lastHp or distInt ~= entry.lastDist) then
						entry.lastHp = hpInt
						entry.lastDist = distInt
						local tagPrefix = t.isPlayer and "[PLR]" or "[NPC]"
						entry.lbl.Text = string.format("%s %s | %d HP | %dm", tagPrefix, t.label, hpInt, distInt)
					end
					if cfg.espHpBar then
						local ratio = math.clamp(t.hum.Health / math.max(1, t.hum.MaxHealth), 0, 1)
						entry.hpFill.Size = UDim2.fromScale(ratio, 1)
						entry.hpFill.BackgroundColor3 = ratio > 0.45 and Theme.green or Theme.red
					end
				end

				if cfg.espTracers or need2DBox or cfg.espSkeleton or cfg.espLookVec then
					local sp, onScreen = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(t.root.Position)
					if onScreen and sp.Z > 0 then
						if cfg.espTracers then
							drawLine2D(bottomCenter, Vector2.new(sp.X, sp.Y), 1.5, col, 0.25)
						end
						if need2DBox then
							local _, bSize = t.model:GetBoundingBox()
							local minX, minY, maxX, maxY = projectBoundsAnd3DBox(t.root.CFrame, bSize, col, cfg.espBox3D)
							if cfg.espCornerBox and minX then
								drawCornerBox2D(minX, minY, maxX, maxY, col)
							end
						end
						if cfg.espSkeleton then
							drawSkeletonCached(t.joints, col)
						end
						if cfg.espLookVec and t.head and t.head:IsA("BasePart") then
							local hStart, hOk = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(t.head.Position)
							local hEnd, eOk = cam:WorldToViewportPoint(t.head.Position + t.head.CFrame.LookVector * 4)
							if hOk and eOk and hStart.Z > 0 and hEnd.Z > 0 then
								drawLine2D(Vector2.new(hStart.X, hStart.Y), Vector2.new(hEnd.X, hEnd.Y), 1.5, Theme.green, 0.15)
							end
						end
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end

	for model in pairs(espEntries) do
		if not active[model] or not model.Parent then
			removeEsp(model)
		end
	end
	endLineBatch()
end

local savedHitboxes = {}
local function updateHitboxes()
	for part, oldData in pairs(savedHitboxes) do
		if not part or not part.Parent or not cfg.hitboxExpandEnabled then
			if part and part.Parent then
				pcall(function()
					part.Size = oldData.size
					part.Transparency = oldData.transparency
					part.CanCollide = oldData.canCollide
				end)
			end
			savedHitboxes[part] = nil
		end
	end
	if not cfg.hitboxExpandEnabled then return end
	for _, t in ipairs(getTargets(cfg.targetNpcs, cfg.targetPlayers)) do
		local tPart = getAimPartFromTarget(t)
		if tPart and tPart:IsA("BasePart") and not savedHitboxes[tPart] then
			savedHitboxes[tPart] = {
				size = tPart.Size,
				transparency = tPart.Transparency,
				canCollide = tPart.CanCollide,
			}
			pcall(function()
				tPart.Size = Vector3.new(cfg.hitboxSize, cfg.hitboxSize, cfg.hitboxSize)
				tPart.Transparency = 0.65
				tPart.CanCollide = false
			end)
		end
	end
end

local function applyNoclip()
	if not cfg.noclipEnabled then return end
	local char = lp.Character
	if not char then return end
	for _, obj in ipairs(char:GetDescendants()) do
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") and obj.CanCollide then
			obj.CanCollide = false
		end
	end
end

local lastTriggerShot = 0
local lastRapidShot = 0
local lastEspTick = 0
local lastHudTick = 0
local frameCounter = 0

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function(dt)
	if not alive then return end
	applyNoclip()
	cam = Workspace.CurrentCamera
	local char = lp.Character
	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
	local root = char and char:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
	local now = os.clock()

	frameCounter += 1
	if (now - lastHudTick) >= 0.35 then
		local fps = math.floor(frameCounter / (now - lastHudTick) + 0.5)
		frameCounter = 0
		lastHudTick = now
		local npcCount = 0
		for _ in pairs(cachedNpcModels) do npcCount += 1 end
		local plrCount = math.max(0, #Players:GetPlayers() - 1)
		fpsLbl.Text = string.format("FPS: %d | NPCs: %d | Plrs: %d", fps, npcCount, plrCount)
	end

	if spectating and cam then
		local targetPlr = Players:FindFirstChild(selectedPlayerName)
		local tHum = targetPlr and targetPlr.Character and targetPlr.Character:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")
		if tHum then
			cam.CameraSubject = tHum
		end
	end

	if cfg.freeCamEnabled and cam then
		local delta = UserInputService:GetMouseDelta()
		freeCamRot = Vector2.new(
			math.clamp(freeCamRot.X - delta.Y * 0.004, -1.5, 1.5),
			freeCamRot.Y - delta.X * 0.004
		)
		local rotCf = CFrame.fromOrientation(freeCamRot.X, freeCamRot.Y, 0)
		local move = Vector3.zero
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.W) then move += rotCf.LookVector end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.S) then move -= rotCf.LookVector end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.D) then move += rotCf.RightVector end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.A) then move -= rotCf.RightVector end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.E) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then move += Vector3.yAxis end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Q) or UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then move -= Vector3.yAxis end
		if move.Magnitude > 0 then
			freeCamPos += move.Unit * cfg.freeCamSpeed * dt
		end
		cam.CFrame = CFrame.new(freeCamPos) * rotCf
	end

	if cfg.gravityEnabled then
		Workspace.Gravity = cfg.gravityVal
	end

	if hum then
		if cfg.speedEnabled then
			hum.WalkSpeed = cfg.walkSpeed
		end
		if cfg.jumpEnabled then
			hum.UseJumpPower = true
			hum.JumpPower = cfg.jumpPower
		end
		if cfg.hipHeightEnabled then
			hum.HipHeight = cfg.hipHeight
		end
		if cfg.bhopEnabled and hum.FloorMaterial ~= Enum.Material.Air and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			hum:ChangeState(Enum.HumanoidStateType.Jumping)
		end
	end

	if cfg.flyEnabled and root and cam and not cfg.freeCamEnabled then
		local moveVec = Vector3.zero
		if hum and hum.MoveDirection.Magnitude > 0 then
			local rightFlat = Vector3.new(cam.CFrame.RightVector.X, 0, cam.CFrame.RightVector.Z)
			if rightFlat.Magnitude > 0 then rightFlat = rightFlat.Unit end
			local forwardAmt = hum.MoveDirection:Dot(cam.CFrame.LookVector)
			local rightAmt = hum.MoveDirection:Dot(cam.CFrame.RightVector)
			moveVec = (cam.CFrame.LookVector * forwardAmt) + (rightFlat * rightAmt)
		end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.Space) then moveVec += Vector3.yAxis end
		if UserInputService:IsKeyDown(Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl) then moveVec -= Vector3.yAxis end
		root.AssemblyLinearVelocity = Vector3.zero
		if moveVec.Magnitude > 0 then
			root.CFrame = root.CFrame + (moveVec.Unit * cfg.flySpeed * dt)
		end
	end

	if cfg.spinEnabled and root then
		root.CFrame = root.CFrame * CFrame.Angles(0, math.rad(cfg.spinSpeed * 12) * dt, 0)
	end

	if cfg.fovEnabled and cam then
		cam.FieldOfView = cfg.fovValue
	end

	local aimActive = cfg.aimbotEnabled and (not cfg.aimbotHoldOnly or UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton2))
	if aimActive and cam and not cfg.freeCamEnabled then
		local targetPart = getClosestTarget(cfg.aimbotFov)
		if targetPart then
			local desired = CFrame.lookAt(cam.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position)
			cam.CFrame = cam.CFrame:Lerp(desired, math.clamp(cfg.aimbotSmooth / 100, 0.05, 1))
		end
	end

	if cfg.noCooldownEnabled and char then
		clearGunCooldowns()
	end

	if (cfg.triggerBotEnabled or cfg.triggerBoxEnabled) and char then
		local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		local trigTarget = nil
		if cfg.triggerBoxEnabled then
			trigTarget = getTargetInTriggerZone(true, cfg.triggerBoxSize, cfg.silentAimFov)
		end
		if not trigTarget and cfg.triggerBotEnabled then
			trigTarget = getTargetInTriggerZone(false, cfg.triggerBoxSize, cfg.silentAimFov)
		end
		if tool and trigTarget and (now - lastTriggerShot) >= (cfg.triggerDelay / 1000) then
			lastTriggerShot = now
			fireEquippedGun(trigTarget)
		end
	end

	if cfg.rapidFireEnabled and char then
		local tool = char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Tool")
		local holdingFire = UserInputService:IsMouseButtonPressed(Enum.UserInputType.MouseButton1)
		if tool and holdingFire and (now - lastRapidShot) >= 0.045 then
			lastRapidShot = now
			local targetPart = cfg.silentAimEnabled and getClosestTarget(cfg.silentAimFov) or nil
			fireEquippedGun(targetPart)
		end
	end

	if cfg.hitboxExpandEnabled then
		updateHitboxes()
	end

	if (now - lastEspTick) >= (1 / math.max(15, cfg.espRefreshRate)) then
		lastEspTick = now
		updateEsp()
	end
end)

scripts.title: Aimbot script
scripts.author: ilovebacons
scripts.summary: Features: AIMBOT •aimbot •wall check •team check •aim part(head or torso) •smoothness ESP •esp •esp team check •esp color picker HITBOX •hitbox expander •hitbox size FOV •FOV circle •FOV circle radius •FOV circle color picker
scripts.code:
-- Services
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local RunService = game:GetService("RunService")
local UserInputService = game:GetService("UserInputService")
local Workspace = game:GetService("Workspace")
local CoreGui = game:GetService("CoreGui")

local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Camera = Workspace.CurrentCamera

-- Load Rayfield UI Library
local Rayfield = loadstring(game:HttpGet('https://sirius.menu/rayfield'))()

-- Configuration Settings
local Settings = {
    AimbotEnabled = false,
    TeamCheck = true,
    WallCheck = true,
    AimPart = "Head",
    Smoothness = 0.4,
    
    ESPEnabled = false,
    ESPTeamCheck = true,
    ESPColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 100),
    
    -- Hitbox Expander Settings
    HitboxEnabled = false,
    HitboxSize = 3,
    
    FOVEnabled = true,
    FOVRadius = 120,
    FOVColor = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255)
}

-- Store original sizes to revert when disabled
local originalSizes = {}

-- Create Rayfield Window (Renamed script title)
local Window = Rayfield:CreateWindow({
    Name = "Rayfield Aimbot Script",
    LoadingTitle = "Loading Rayfield Aimbot...",
    LoadingSubtitle = "by Universal Framework",
    ConfigurationSaving = {
        Enabled = false,
    },
    KeySystem = false,
})

-- ==================== TABS ====================
local AimbotTab = Window:CreateTab("Aimbot", 4483362458)
local ESPTab = Window:CreateTab("ESP", 4483345998)
local HitboxTab = Window:CreateTab("Hitbox", 4483362458)
local FOVTab = Window:CreateTab("FOV", 4483362458)

-- ==================== AIMBOT TAB ====================
AimbotTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Aimbot Enabled",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "AimbotToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.AimbotEnabled = Value
    end,
})

AimbotTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Team Check",
    CurrentValue = true,
    Flag = "TeamCheckToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.TeamCheck = Value
    end,
})

AimbotTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Wall Check",
    CurrentValue = true,
    Flag = "WallCheckToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.WallCheck = Value
    end,
})

AimbotTab:CreateDropdown({
    Name = "Target Part",
    Options = {"Head", "Torso"},
    CurrentOption = "Head",
    Flag = "AimPartDropdown",
    Callback = function(Option)
        if Option == "Torso" then
            Settings.AimPart = "HumanoidRootPart"
        else
            Settings.AimPart = "Head"
        end
    end,
})

AimbotTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Smoothness",
    Range = {0.05, 1},
    Increment = 0.05,
    CurrentValue = 0.4,
    Flag = "SmoothnessSlider",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.Smoothness = Value
    end,
})

-- ==================== ESP TAB ====================
ESPTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "ESP Highlight Enabled",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "ESPToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.ESPEnabled = Value
    end,
})

ESPTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "ESP Team Check",
    CurrentValue = true,
    Flag = "ESPTeamCheckToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.ESPTeamCheck = Value
    end,
})

ESPTab:CreateColorPicker({
    Name = "ESP Color",
    Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 50, 100),
    Flag = "ESPColorPicker",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.ESPColor = Value
    end,
})

-- ==================== HITBOX TAB ====================
HitboxTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Hitbox Expander Enabled",
    CurrentValue = false,
    Flag = "HitboxToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.HitboxEnabled = Value
        if not Value then
            for player, data in pairs(originalSizes) do
                if player and player.Character then
                    local rootPart = player.Character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if rootPart and data[rootPart] then
                        rootPart.Size = data[rootPart]
                        rootPart.Transparency = 0
                        rootPart.CanCollide = true
                    end
                end
            end
            originalSizes = {}
        end
    end,
})

HitboxTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "Hitbox Size",
    Range = {1, 15},
    Increment = 1,
    CurrentValue = 3,
    Flag = "HitboxSizeSlider",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.HitboxSize = Value
    end,
})

-- ==================== FOV TAB ====================
FOVTab:CreateToggle({
    Name = "Show FOV Circle",
    CurrentValue = true,
    Flag = "FOVToggle",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.FOVEnabled = Value
    end,
})

FOVTab:CreateSlider({
    Name = "FOV Radius",
    Range = {50, 400},
    Increment = 5,
    CurrentValue = 120,
    Flag = "FOVRadiusSlider",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.FOVRadius = Value
    end,
})

FOVTab:CreateColorPicker({
    Name = "FOV Circle Color",
    Color = Color3.fromRGB(255, 255, 255),
    Flag = "FOVColorPicker",
    Callback = function(Value)
        Settings.FOVColor = Value
    end,
})

-- ==================== FOV CIRCLE GUI CREATION ====================
local FOVGui = Instance.new("ScreenGui")
FOVGui.Name = "CenterFOVGui"
FOVGui.ResetOnSpawn = false
FOVGui.Parent = CoreGui

local FOVFrame = Instance.new("Frame")
FOVFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, Settings.FOVRadius * 2, 0, Settings.FOVRadius * 2)
FOVFrame.AnchorPoint = Vector2.new(0.5, 0.5)
FOVFrame.BackgroundTransparency = 1
FOVFrame.Visible = true
FOVFrame.Parent = FOVGui

local FOVStroke = Instance.new("UIStroke")
FOVStroke.Thickness = 1.5
FOVStroke.Color = Settings.FOVColor
FOVStroke.Parent = FOVFrame

local FOVCircleCorner = Instance.new("UICorner")
FOVCircleCorner.CornerRadius = UDim.new(1, 0)
FOVCircleCorner.Parent = FOVFrame

-- ==================== LOGIC / EXECUTION ENGINE ====================
local highlights = {}

local function removeHighlight(player)
    if highlights[player] then
        highlights[player]:Destroy()
        highlights[player] = nil
    end
end

-- Robust character hook for respawns
local function setupPlayerESP(player)
    player.CharacterAdded:Connect(function(char)
        if not highlights[player] then
            local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
            hl.Parent = CoreGui
            highlights[player] = hl
        end
        highlights[player].Adornee = char
    end)
    
    player.CharacterRemoving:Connect(function()
        removeHighlight(player)
    end)
end

for _, p in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
    if p ~= LocalPlayer then
        setupPlayerESP(p)
    end
end

Players.PlayerAdded:Connect(function(p)
    if p ~= LocalPlayer then
        setupPlayerESP(p)
    end
end)

Players.PlayerRemoving:Connect(function(player)
    removeHighlight(player)
    originalSizes[player] = nil
end)

local function isVisible(targetPart)
    if not Settings.WallCheck then return true end
    local origin = Camera.CFrame.Position
    local direction = (targetPart.Position - origin)
    
    local raycastParams = RaycastParams.new()
    raycastParams.FilterType = Enum.RaycastFilterType.Blacklist
    raycastParams.FilterDescendantsInstances = {LocalPlayer.Character, Camera}
    
    local result = Workspace:Raycast(origin, direction, raycastParams)
    if result then
        local hitPart = result.Instance
        if hitPart:IsDescendantOf(targetPart.Parent) then
            return true
        end
        return false
    end
    return true
end

local function getClosestTarget()
    local closestPlayer = nil
    local shortestDistance = Settings.FOVRadius
    local screenCenter = Vector2.new(Camera.ViewportSize.X / 2, (Camera.ViewportSize.Y / 2) - 35)
    
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            if Settings.TeamCheck and player.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team then
                continue
            end
            
            local character = player.Character
            if character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                local targetPart = character:FindFirstChild(Settings.AimPart) or character:FindFirstChild("Head")
                if targetPart then
                    if isVisible(targetPart) then
                        local screenPos, onScreen = Camera:WorldToViewportPoint(targetPart.Position)
                        if onScreen then
                            local screenVector = Vector2.new(screenPos.X, screenPos.Y)
                            local centerDist = (screenVector - screenCenter).Magnitude
                            
                            if centerDist < shortestDistance then
                                shortestDistance = centerDist
                                closestPlayer = character
                            end
                        end
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    return closestPlayer
end

-- Render loop for ESP, Hitbox Expander, FOV, and Aimbot
RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    local viewportCenter = Camera.ViewportSize / 2
    FOVFrame.Position = UDim2.new(0, viewportCenter.X, 0, viewportCenter.Y - 35)
    FOVFrame.Visible = Settings.FOVEnabled
    FOVFrame.Size = UDim2.new(0, Settings.FOVRadius * 2, 0, Settings.FOVRadius * 2)
    FOVStroke.Color = Settings.FOVColor
    
    -- Handle Hitbox Expander
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local isTeammate = (player.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team)
            local character = player.Character
            
            if Settings.HitboxEnabled and character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                if not (Settings.TeamCheck and isTeammate) then
                    local rootPart = character:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
                    if rootPart then
                        if not originalSizes[player] then
                            originalSizes[player] = {}
                        end
                        if not originalSizes[player][rootPart] then
                            originalSizes[player][rootPart] = rootPart.Size
                        end
                        rootPart.Size = Vector3.new(Settings.HitboxSize, Settings.HitboxSize, Settings.HitboxSize)
                        rootPart.Transparency = 0.6
                        rootPart.CanCollide = false
                    end
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Handle ESP & Chams
    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= LocalPlayer then
            local character = player.Character
            local isTeammate = (player.Team and LocalPlayer.Team and player.Team == LocalPlayer.Team)
            
            local showESP = Settings.ESPEnabled
            if Settings.ESPTeamCheck and isTeammate then
                showESP = false
            end
            
            if showESP and character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0 then
                if not highlights[player] then
                    local hl = Instance.new("Highlight")
                    hl.Parent = CoreGui
                    highlights[player] = hl
                end
                
                local hl = highlights[player]
                if hl.Adornee ~= character then
                    hl.Adornee = character
                end
                
                hl.FillColor = Settings.ESPColor
                hl.FillTransparency = 0.2
                hl.OutlineTransparency = 1
            else
                if highlights[player] then
                    highlights[player].Adornee = nil
                end
            end
        end
    end
    
    -- Handle Aimbot Vector Locking
    if Settings.AimbotEnabled then
        local target = getClosestTarget()
        if target and target:FindFirstChild(Settings.AimPart) then
            local targetPart = target[Settings.AimPart]
            local targetCFrame = CFrame.new(Camera.CFrame.Position, targetPart.Position)
            Camera.CFrame = Camera.CFrame:Lerp(targetCFrame, Settings.Smoothness)
        end
    end
end)

local players = game:GetService("Players")
local rs = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage")
local env = (getgenv and getgenv()) or _G

if type(env.chukunhax_stop) == "function" then pcall(env.chukunhax_stop) end

local chukunhax = env.chukunhax or {}
env.chukunhax = chukunhax

	if chukunhax[key] == nil then chukunhax[key] = value end
end

local undo = {}
local function alive() return env.chukunhax_token == token end

env.chukunhax_stop = function()
	env.chukunhax_token = nil
	for i = #undo, 1, -1 do pcall(undo[i]) end

	local ok, module = pcall(require, inst)
	return ok and module or nil
end

local controllers = lp:WaitForChild("PlayerScripts"):WaitForChild("Client"):WaitForChild("Controllers")
local shared = rs:WaitForChild("Shared")
local state = load(controllers:WaitForChild("ClientState"))
local meter = load(controllers:WaitForChild("ThrowMeter"))
local game_config = load(rs:WaitForChild("Config"):WaitForChild("GameConfig"))
local meter_math = load(shared:WaitForChild("ThrowMeterMath"))

	local hum = char and char:FindFirstChildOfClass("Humanoid")

local function loop(delay, fn)

			pcall(fn)
			task.wait(delay)
		end
	end)

local orig_arc = arc and arc.CreateArc
if orig_arc then
	arc.CreateArc = function(a, b, time, ...)
		if chukunhax.fastthrow and type(time) == "number" then
			time = math.max(0.35, time / speed())
		end
		return orig_arc(a, b, time, ...)
	end
	undo[#undo + 1] = function() arc.CreateArc = orig_arc end
end

local orig_play = anim and anim.Play
if orig_play then
	anim.Play = function(rig, id, ...)
		local track = orig_play(rig, id, ...)
		if chukunhax.fastthrow and track and id == anim.GetThrowId() then
			pcall(track.AdjustSpeed, track, speed())
		end
		return track
	end
	undo[#undo + 1] = function() anim.Play = orig_play end
end

local sequence_keys = { "FadeIn", "FadeOut", "POVDuration", "RevealZoomNormal", "RevealZoomDramatic", "ShowTimeNormal", "ShowTimeShort", "SkipAfterRevealDelay" }
local sequence_original

local function sync_sequence()
	local sequence = game_config and game_config.Sequence
	if not sequence then return end
	if not sequence_original then
		sequence_original = {}
		for _, key in ipairs(sequence_keys) do sequence_original[key] = sequence[key] end
		undo[#undo + 1] = function()
			for key, value in pairs(sequence_original) do sequence[key] = value end
		end
	end
	for _, key in ipairs(sequence_keys) do
		if sequence_original[key] then
			sequence[key] = chukunhax.fastthrow and math.max(0.08, sequence_original[key] / chukunhax.fastspeed) or sequence_original[key]
		end
	end
end

local function sync_meter()
	if not (meter and meter_math) then return end
	if chukunhax.perfectthrow then
		meter.TestAutoTap = meter_math.HalfPeriod() - (0.005 + math.random() * 0.002)
	else
		meter.TestAutoTap = nil
	end
end
undo[#undo + 1] = function() if meter then meter.TestAutoTap = nil end end

local last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()

local function walk_to(pos, tolerance)
	local _, root, hum = character()
	if not root or root.Anchored then return false end
	local flat = Vector3.new(root.Position.X - pos.X, 0, root.Position.Z - pos.Z).Magnitude
	if flat <= tolerance then
		last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()
		return true
	end
	hum:MoveTo(pos)
	if flat < last_distance - 1 then
		last_distance, last_progress = flat, os.clock()
	elseif os.clock() - last_progress > 3 then
		root.CFrame = CFrame.new(pos + Vector3.new(0, 3, 0))
		last_distance, last_progress = math.huge, os.clock()
	end
	return false
end

local function throw_target()
	local area = workspace:FindFirstChild("StarterArea")
	if not area then return end
	local line = area:FindFirstChild("CrossLine")
	local z = line and line.Position.Z or area.Position.Z + area.Size.Z / 2
	local _, root = character()
	local x = root and math.clamp(root.Position.X, area.Position.X - area.Size.X / 2 + 3, area.Position.X + area.Size.X / 2 - 3) or area.Position.X
	return Vector3.new(x, area.Position.Y + area.Size.Y / 2 + 3, z - 3)
end

loop(0.35, function()
	sync_meter()
	sync_sequence()
	local _, root = character()
	if not root or not chukunhax.autothrow then return end
	if state and (state.Busy or state.OfflineOpen) or root.Anchored then return end
	local target = throw_target()
	if target then walk_to(target, 1.5) end
end)

local keyMap = {
	["0"] = Enum.KeyCode.Zero, ["1"] = Enum.KeyCode.One, ["2"] = Enum.KeyCode.Two,
	["3"] = Enum.KeyCode.Three, ["4"] = Enum.KeyCode.Four, ["5"] = Enum.KeyCode.Five,
	["6"] = Enum.KeyCode.Six, ["7"] = Enum.KeyCode.Seven, ["8"] = Enum.KeyCode.Eight,
	["9"] = Enum.KeyCode.Nine, ["SPACE"] = Enum.KeyCode.Space, ["SPACEBAR"] = Enum.KeyCode.Space,
	[" "] = Enum.KeyCode.Space, ["LEFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left, ["ARROWLEFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left,
	["←"] = Enum.KeyCode.Left, ["RIGHT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right, ["ARROWRIGHT"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right,
	["→"] = Enum.KeyCode.Right, ["UP"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up, ["ARROWUP"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up,
	["↑"] = Enum.KeyCode.Up, ["DOWN"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down, ["ARROWDOWN"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down,
	["↓"] = Enum.KeyCode.Down, [";"] = Enum.KeyCode.Semicolon, ["'"] = Enum.KeyCode.Quote,
	[","] = Enum.KeyCode.Comma, ["."] = Enum.KeyCode.Period, ["/"] = Enum.KeyCode.Slash,
	["\\"] = Enum.KeyCode.BackSlash, ["["] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftBracket, ["]"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightBracket,
	["-"] = Enum.KeyCode.Minus, ["="] = Enum.KeyCode.Equals, ["LSHIFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftShift,
	["RSHIFT"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightShift, ["LCTRL"] = Enum.KeyCode.LeftControl, ["RCTRL"] = Enum.KeyCode.RightControl,
}

local enumList = Enum.KeyCode:GetEnumItems()

local function parseKey(txt)
	if type(txt) ~= "string" then return nil, "?" end
	local s = txt:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$")
	if s == "" then return nil, "?" end
	s = s:gsub("^Enum%.KeyCode%.", "")
	local br = s:match("^%[(.-)%]$")
	if br then s = br:match("^%s*(.-)%s*$") end
	local up = s:upper()

	if keyMap[up] then return keyMap[up], s end

	local ok1, e1 = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[s] end)
	if ok1 and typeof(e1) == "EnumItem" then return e1, s end

	local ok2, e2 = pcall(function() return Enum.KeyCode[up] end)
	if ok2 and typeof(e2) == "EnumItem" then return e2, up end

	for _, v in ipairs(enumList) do
		if v.Name:upper() == up then
			return v, v.Name
		end
	end
	return nil, s
end

local function grabKey(rec)
	local k = rec:FindFirstChild("Key")
	local raw
	if k then
		if k:IsA("TextLabel") or k:IsA("TextButton") or k:IsA("TextBox") then
			raw = k.Text
		elseif k:IsA("StringValue") then
			raw = k.Value
		elseif k:IsA("IntValue") or k:IsA("NumberValue") then
			raw = tostring(k.Value)
		end
	end
	if (not raw or raw == "") and rec:GetAttribute("Key") ~= nil then
		raw = tostring(rec:GetAttribute("Key"))
	end
	return parseKey(raw)
end

local hasFire = type(firesignal) == "function"
local hasConns = type(getconnections) == "function"

local function fireSig(sig, ...)
	if hasFire then
		pcall(firesignal, sig, ...)
	elseif hasConns then
		local ok, list = pcall(getconnections, sig)
		if ok and type(list) == "table" then
			for _, c in ipairs(list) do
				if c.Enabled ~= false then
					if type(c.Fire) == "function" then
						pcall(c.Fire, c, ...)
					elseif type(c.Function) == "function" then
						pcall(c.Function, ...)
					end
				end
			end
		end
	end
end

local function gotConns(sig)
	if not hasConns then return false end
	local ok, list = pcall(getconnections, sig)
	return ok and type(list) == "table" and #list > 0
end

local function midOf(b)
	local p, sz = b.AbsolutePosition, b.AbsoluteSize
	return p.X + sz.X * 0.5, p.Y + sz.Y * 0.5
end

local function pressBtn(b)
	local x, y = midOf(b)
	if not hasFire and not hasConns then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, true, game, 1) end)
		return
	end
	local sent = false
	if gotConns(b.MouseButton1Down) then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Down, x, y)
		sent = true
	end
	if gotConns(b.InputBegan) then
		fireSig(b.InputBegan, {
			UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
			UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
			Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			Delta = Vector3.zero,
			KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
		}, false)
		sent = true
	end
	if not sent then
		if gotConns(b.Activated) then
			fireSig(b.Activated, {
				UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
				UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.Begin,
				Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			}, 1)
			sent = true
		elseif gotConns(b.MouseButton1Click) then
			fireSig(b.MouseButton1Click)
			sent = true
		elseif gotConns(b.TouchTap) then
			fireSig(b.TouchTap, { Vector2.new(x, y) })
			sent = true
		end
	end
	if not sent and hasFire then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Down, x, y)
	end
end

local function releaseBtn(b)
	local x, y = midOf(b)
	if not hasFire and not hasConns then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendMouseButtonEvent(x, y, 0, false, game, 1) end)
		return
	end
	local sent = false
	if gotConns(b.MouseButton1Up) then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Up, x, y)
		sent = true
	end
	if gotConns(b.InputEnded) then
		fireSig(b.InputEnded, {
			UserInputType = Enum.UserInputType.Touch,
			UserInputState = Enum.UserInputState.End,
			Position = Vector3.new(x, y, 0),
			Delta = Vector3.zero,
			KeyCode = Enum.KeyCode.Unknown,
		}, false)
		sent = true
	end
	if not sent and not hasConns and hasFire then
		fireSig(b.MouseButton1Up, x, y)
	end
end

	local d = down[idx]
	if not d then return end
	down[idx] = nil
	if d.m == "Key" and d.k then
		pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(false, d.k, false, game) end)
	elseif d.m == "Touch" and d.b and d.b.Parent then
		releaseBtn(d.b)
	end
end

local function press(info)
	local idx = info.idx
	if down[idx] then rel(idx) end
	if mode == "Touch" then
		if not info.btn then return false end
		down[idx] = { m = "Touch", b = info.btn }
		pressBtn(info.btn)
		return true
	else

		down[idx] = { m = "Key", k = info.key }
		pcall(function() VIM:SendKeyEvent(true, info.key, false, game) end)
		return true
	end
end

local function checkHit(obj, rec)
	local gp, gs = obj.AbsolutePosition, obj.AbsoluteSize
	local rp, rs = rec.AbsolutePosition, rec.AbsoluteSize
	if gs.X <= 1 or gs.Y <= 1 or rs.X <= 1 or rs.Y <= 1 then return false, false end

	local cx = gp.X + gs.X * 0.5
	if cx < rp.X or cx > (rp.X + rs.X) then return false, false end

	local hit = (gp.Y + gs.Y >= rp.Y - off) and (gp.Y <= rp.Y + rs.Y)
	return hit, gs.Y > (rs.Y * 1.6)
end

local function findTail(note, rec, tails)
	local np, ns = note.AbsolutePosition, note.AbsoluteSize
	local nt, nb = np.Y, np.Y + ns.Y
	local rp, rs = rec.AbsolutePosition, rec.AbsoluteSize
	local rl, rr = rp.X, rp.X + rs.X

	local best, bestD = nil, math.huge
	for _, tl in ipairs(tails) do
		if tl.Visible then
			local tp, ts = tl.AbsolutePosition, tl.AbsoluteSize
			if ts.X > 1 and ts.Y > 1 then
				local tx = tp.X + ts.X * 0.5
				if tx >= rl and tx <= rr then

local rs, plrs, ws = game:GetService("ReplicatedStorage"), game:GetService("Players"), game:GetService("Workspace")
local lp = plrs.LocalPlayer

local chukunhax = {
	silent = true,
	hitchance = 80,
	corner = 78,
	spread = 1.4,
	perfectcharge = true,
	tackleaim = true,
	stamina = true,
}

local function mod(...)
	local n = rs
	for _, v in ipairs({ ... }) do n = n and n:FindFirstChild(v) end
	local ok, m = pcall(require, n)
	return ok and m or nil
end

local proto = mod("Modules", "Actions", "ActionRemoteProtocol")
local cmds = mod("Modules", "Actions", "ActionCommands")
local sprint = mod("Modules", "Actions", "Sprint")
local teams = mod("Client", "Gameplay", "ActorTeams")
local match = mod("Modules", "Gameplay", "MatchSettings")

local function getroot(c)
	return c and c:FindFirstChild("HumanoidRootPart")
end

local function goals()
	local d = ws:FindFirstChild("Map") and ws.Map:FindFirstChild("Data")
	local a, b = d and d:FindFirstChild("Team1"), d and d:FindFirstChild("Team2")
	return a and a:FindFirstChild("Goal"), b and b:FindFirstChild("Goal")
end

local function enemygoal()
	local a, b = goals()
	if not (a and b) then return a or b end
	local ok, mine = pcall(teams.GetCharacterTeamName, lp.Character)
	local ok2, opp = ok and pcall(match.GetOpposingTeamName, mine)
	if ok2 and opp == "Team1" then return a end
	if ok2 and opp == "Team2" then return b end
	local r = getroot(lp.Character)
	if not r then return a end
	return (a.Position - r.Position).Magnitude > (b.Position - r.Position).Magnitude and a or b
end

local function keeper(goal)
	local best, dist = nil, 1e9
	for _, p in ipairs(plrs:GetPlayers()) do
		local r = p ~= lp and p.Team ~= lp.Team and getroot(p.Character)
		if r then
			local d = (r.Position - goal.Position).Magnitude
			if d < dist then best, dist = r, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function spot(goal)
	local side = math.random() > 0.5 and 1 or -1
	local k = keeper(goal)
	if k then side = goal.CFrame:PointToObjectSpace(k.Position).X > 0 and -1 or 1 end
	local x = side * goal.Size.X / 2 * (chukunhax.corner / 100)
	local y = goal.Size.Y / 2 * 0.8
	local jx = (math.random() - 0.5) * 2 * chukunhax.spread
	local jy = (math.random() - 0.5) * chukunhax.spread
	return (goal.CFrame * CFrame.new(x + jx, y + jy, 0)).Position
end

local function isshot(c)
	if c.Mode == "Volley" then return true end
	if cmds and typeof(cmds.IsVolley) == "function" then
		local ok, v = pcall(cmds.IsVolley, c)
		if ok and v then return true end
	end
	return c.PassType == "Shot"
end

local function closest()
	local me = getroot(lp.Character)
	local best, dist = nil, 25
	for _, p in ipairs(plrs:GetPlayers()) do
		local r = p ~= lp and p.Team ~= lp.Team and getroot(p.Character)
		if r and me then
			local d = (r.Position - me.Position).Magnitude
			if d < dist then best, dist = p, d end
		end
	end
	return best
end

local function aimat(c, pos)
	local aim = c.AimDirection
	local has = typeof(aim) == "table"
	local origin = has and aim.Origin
	if typeof(origin) ~= "Vector3" then
		local r = getroot(lp.Character)
		origin = r and r.Position
	end
	if not origin or (pos - origin).Magnitude < 0.1 then return end
	local dir = (pos - origin).Unit
	if has then
		aim.TargetPosition = pos
		aim.Direction = dir
	end
	c.TargetPosition = pos
	local flat = Vector3.new(dir.X, 0, dir.Z)
	if flat.Magnitude > 0 then c.KickDirection = flat.Unit end
end

local function edit(c)
	if chukunhax.perfectcharge and c.MaximumChargeSeconds then
		c.ChargeSeconds = c.MaximumChargeSeconds
	end
	if chukunhax.silent and isshot(c) and math.random(100) <= chukunhax.hitchance then
		local g = enemygoal()
		if g then aimat(c, spot(g)) end
	end
	if chukunhax.tackleaim and cmds and c.Kind == cmds.Kinds.Tackle and typeof(c.AimDirection) == "table" then
		local p = closest()
		local r = p and getroot(p.Character)
		if r then
			c.AimDirection.ClientHit = { Kind = "Player", UserId = p.UserId }
			c.TargetUserId = p.UserId
			aimat(c, r.Position)
		end
	end
end

for _, name in ipairs({ "Send", "Start", "Update", "Release" }) do
	local og = proto[name]
	if typeof(og) == "function" then
		proto[name] = function(c, ...)
			if typeof(c) == "table" then pcall(edit, c) end
			return og(c, ...)
		end
	end
end

if chukunhax.stamina and sprint and sprint.SetUnlimitedStamina then
	pcall(sprint.SetUnlimitedStamina, lp, "hax", true)
end

local function UpdateScrollingFrame()
    local totalHeight = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextBox") or child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("Frame") then
            totalHeight = totalHeight + child.Size.Y.Offset + 5
        end
    end
    G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"].CanvasSize = UDim2.new(0, 0, 0, totalHeight)
    
    local yOffset = 0
    for _, child in ipairs(G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]:GetChildren()) do
        if child:IsA("TextBox") or child:IsA("TextLabel") or child:IsA("Frame") then
            child.Position = UDim2.new(0, 5, 0, yOffset)
            yOffset = yOffset + child.Size.Y.Offset + 5
        end
    end
    
    G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"].CanvasPosition = Vector2.new(0, totalHeight)
end


local function CallGeminiAPI(userMessage)
    local body = HttpService:JSONEncode({
        contents = {{ parts = {{ text = userMessage }} }}
    })
    
    local success, response = pcall(function()
        return request({
            Url = "https://generativelanguage.googleapis.com/v1beta/models/gemini-2.0-flash-exp:generateContent?key=" .. Api_Gemini67,
            Method = "POST",
            Headers = {
                ["Content-Type"] = "application/json"
            },
            Body = body
        })
    end)
    
    if not success then
        return "Error: Request failed - " .. tostring(response)
    end
    
    if not response or not response.Body then
        return "Error: No response from server"
    end
    
    local decodeSuccess, data = pcall(function()
        return HttpService:JSONDecode(response.Body)
    end)
    
    if not decodeSuccess then
        return "Error: Invalid response format - " .. tostring(data)
    end
    
    if data and data.candidates and data.candidates[1] and 
       data.candidates[1].content and data.candidates[1].content.parts and
       data.candidates[1].content.parts[1] and data.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text then
        local aiText = data.candidates[1].content.parts[1].text
        return aiText
    end
    
    if data and data.error then
        return "API Error: " .. (data.error.message or "Unknown error")
    end
    
    return "Error: Unable to parse AI response. Check console for details."
end

local function CallAI(userMessage)
    if currentAI == "Gemini" then
        return CallGeminiAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Claude" then
        return CallClaudeAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ClaudeApi)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Llama" then
        return CallGroqLlamaAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "(Groq) Gpt Oss" then
        return CallGroqGptOssAPI(userMessage)
    elseif currentAI == "Gpt-4" then
        return CallChatGPTAPI(userMessage, getgenv().ChatGptApi)
    else
        return "Please select an AI model from the settings"
    end
end

local function ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local parts = {}
    local lastIndex = 1
    
    for codeStart, language, code, codeEnd in message:gmatch("()```([%w]*)\n?(.-)\n?```()") do
        if codeStart > lastIndex then
            local textBefore = message:sub(lastIndex, codeStart - 1)
            if textBefore:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
                table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textBefore})
            end
        end
        
        table.insert(parts, {type = "code", content = code, language = language})
        lastIndex = codeEnd
    end
    
    if lastIndex <= #message then
        local textAfter = message:sub(lastIndex)
        if textAfter:gsub("%s+", "") ~= "" then
            table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = textAfter})
        end
    end
    
    if #parts == 0 then
        table.insert(parts, {type = "text", content = message})
    end
    
    return parts
end


local function DisplayAIResponse(message)
    local parts = ExtractCodeBlocks(message)
    local senderAdded = false
    
    for i, part in ipairs(parts) do
        if part.type == "text" then
            if not senderAdded then
                AddMessage(currentAI, part.content, false)
                senderAdded = true
            else
                AddMessage("", part.content, false)
            end
        elseif part.type == "code" then
            CreateCodeBlock(part.content, part.language)
        end
    end
end


local function ShowLoadingMessage()
    local loadingLabel = Instance.new("TextLabel")
    loadingLabel.Name = "LoadingMessage"
    loadingLabel.Size = UDim2.new(1, -10, 0, 30)
    loadingLabel.BackgroundTransparency = 1
    loadingLabel.TextColor3 = Color3.fromRGB(200, 200, 200)
    loadingLabel.FontFace = Font.new([[rbxasset://fonts/families/Inconsolata.json]], Enum.FontWeight.Regular, Enum.FontStyle.Normal)
    loadingLabel.TextSize = 14
    loadingLabel.TextXAlignment = Enum.TextXAlignment.Left
    loadingLabel.TextYAlignment = Enum.TextYAlignment.Top
    loadingLabel.Text = currentAI .. ": ..."
    loadingLabel.Parent = G2L["ScrollingFrame_c"]
    
    UpdateScrollingFrame()
    
    local dots = 0
    local animationRunning = true
    
    task.spawn(function()
        while animationRunning and loadingLabel.Parent do
            dots = (dots % 3) + 1
            loadingLabel.Text = currentAI .. ": " .. string.rep(".", dots)
            task.wait(0.5)
        end
    end)
    
    return loadingLabel, function()
        animationRunning = false
    end
end

scripts.author: Tomato
scripts.summary: It does the obby as quick as it can.
scripts.code:
local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local LocalPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer
local Character = LocalPlayer.Character
local RootPart = Character.HumanoidRootPart

local stages = workspace.stages
local currentstage = LocalPlayer.leaderstats.Stage

local function FindNextPortal()
	for i,v in pairs(workspace:GetChildren()) do
		if v.Name == "Stage Teleport" and #v:GetChildren() == 4 then
			local enter = v:FindFirstChild("enter")
			if enter ~= nil then
				return enter
			end
		end
	end
end

local function Touch(Part)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 0)
	firetouchinterest(RootPart, Part, 1)
end
while task.wait() do
	local CurrentStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value))
	local NextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	local NextNextStage = stages:FindFirstChild(tostring(currentstage.Value + 1))
	RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame * CFrame.new(0,3,0)
	if NextStage then
		Touch(NextStage)
		--Potential Speed Gain?
		if NextNextStage then
			Touch(NextNextStage)
		end
	else
		local NextPortal = FindNextPortal()
		if NextPortal then
			RootPart.CFrame = NextPortal.CFrame
		else
			RootPart.CFrame = CurrentStage.CFrame
		end
		task.wait(1)
	end
end
for i,v in pairs(workspace.badges:GetChildren()) do
	if v.Name == "Platform" then
		Touch(v)
	end
end

local originalSounds = {}

local function optimizeGame()
	local Lighting = game:GetService("Lighting")
	Lighting.Technology = Enum.Technology.Compatibility
	Lighting.GlobalShadows = false
	Lighting.ShadowSoftness = 0
	
	local function process(obj)
		if processed[obj] then return end
		processed[obj] = true
		
		if obj:IsA("BasePart") then
			obj.Material = Enum.Material.SmoothPlastic
			obj.CastShadow = false
		elseif obj:IsA("Sound") then
			originalSounds[obj] = obj.SoundId
			if getgenv().StretchConfig.CustomSoundsEnabled then
				obj.SoundId = getgenv().StretchConfig.PopSoundId
			end
		elseif obj:IsA("ParticleEmitter") then
			obj.Texture = getgenv().StretchConfig.DotTexture
			obj.Rate = 5
			obj.Size = NumberSequence.new(0.1)
		end
	end
	
	for _, obj in ipairs(workspace:GetDescendants()) do
		task.spawn(process, obj)
	end
	
	workspace.DescendantAdded:Connect(process)
end

local function randomColor()
    return Color3.new(math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255, math.random(0, 255)/255)
end

-- Função para aplicar uma cor suavemente
local function lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
    return startColor:Lerp(endColor, alpha)
end

-- Tempo de transição (em segundos)
local transitionTime = 0.5

-- Remover camisa e calça do jogador
character.Shirt:Destroy()
character.Pants:Destroy()

-- Loop infinito para alterar as cores do corpo

    local startTime = tick()
    local endTime = startTime + transitionTime
    
    local startColor = randomColor()
    local endColor = randomColor()
    
    while tick() < endTime do
        local elapsedTime = tick() - startTime
        local alpha = elapsedTime / transitionTime
        
        for _, part in ipairs(character:GetDescendants()) do
            if part:IsA("BasePart") then
                part.Color = lerpColor(startColor, endColor, alpha)
                part.Transparency = 0.25
                part.Material = Enum.Material.ForceField -- Aqui está a linha que adiciona o material ForceField
            end
        end
        
        wait()
    end
end
   end

local Players = game:GetService("Players")
local Cam = game.Workspace.CurrentCamera

local FOVring = Drawing.new("Circle")
FOVring.Visible = true
FOVring.Thickness = 2
FOVring.Color = Color3.fromRGB(128, 0, 128)
FOVring.Filled = false
FOVring.Radius = fov
FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2

local function updateDrawings()
    FOVring.Position = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
end

local function lookAt(target)
    local lookVector = (target - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local newCFrame = CFrame.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, Cam.CFrame.Position + lookVector)
    Cam.CFrame = newCFrame
end

local function calculateTransparency(distance)
    return (1 - (distance / fov)) * maxTransparency
end

local function isPlayerAlive(player)
    local character = player.Character
    return character and character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid") and character.Humanoid.Health > 0
end

local function isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, trg_part)
    if not wallCheck then
        return true
    end

    local localPlayerCharacter = Players.LocalPlayer.Character
    if not localPlayerCharacter then
        return false
    end

    local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(trg_part)
    if not part then
        return false
    end

    local ray = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position, part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position)
    local hit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(ray, {localPlayerCharacter})

    if hit and hit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character) then
        return true
    end

    -- Fallback to a nearby position if the direct ray doesn't hit
    local direction = (part.Position - Cam.CFrame.Position).unit
    local nearRay = Ray.new(Cam.CFrame.Position + direction * 2, direction * maxDistance)
    local nearHit, _ = workspace:FindPartOnRayWithIgnoreList(nearRay, {localPlayerCharacter})

    return nearHit and nearHit:IsDescendantOf(player.Character)
end

local function getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    local nearest = nil
    local last = math.huge
    local playerMousePos = Cam.ViewportSize / 2
    local localPlayer = Players.LocalPlayer

    for _, player in ipairs(Players:GetPlayers()) do
        if player ~= localPlayer and (not teamCheck or player.Team ~= localPlayer.Team) and isPlayerAlive(player) then
            local humanoid = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild("Humanoid")
            local part = player.Character and player.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart)
            if humanoid and part then
                local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
                local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - playerMousePos).Magnitude

                if distance < last and isVisible and distance < fov and distance < maxDistance and isPlayerVisibleThroughWalls(player, aimPart) then
                    last = distance
                    nearest = player
                end
            end
        end
    end

    return nearest
end

RunService.RenderStepped:Connect(function()
    updateDrawings()
    local closest = getClosestPlayerInFOV()
    if closest and closest.Character:FindFirstChild(aimPart) then
        lookAt(closest.Character[aimPart].Position)
    end
    
    if closest then
        local part = closest.Character[aimPart]
        local ePos, isVisible = Cam:WorldToViewportPoint(part.Position)
        local distance = (Vector2.new(ePos.x, ePos.y) - (Cam.ViewportSize / 2)).Magnitude
        FOVring.Transparency = calculateTransparency(distance)
    else
        FOVring.Transparency = maxTransparency
    end
end)
        end

local function Descendants(tbl)
    local descendants = {}
    
    local function process_table(subtbl, prefix)
        for k, v in pairs(subtbl) do
            local index = prefix and (prefix .. "." .. tostring(k)) or tostring(k)
            descendants[index] = v
            if type(v) == 'table' then
                process_table(v, index)
            else
                descendants[index] = v
            end
        end
    end

    if type(tbl) ~= 'table' then
        descendants[tostring(1)] = tbl
    else
        process_table(tbl, nil)
    end
    
    return descendants
end

local function rawlength(tbl)

 end
 return a
end

local function ToPairsLoop(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns2) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var1, var2, tbl)
            return p.format:format(var1, var2, tbl)
        end)
    end
    return code
end

local function SafeOverride(a, b, c) --[[ Index, Data, Should override ]]
    if getgenv()[a] and not c then return 1 end
    getgenv()[a] = b

    return 2
end

local function toluau(code)
    for _, p in ipairs(patterns) do
        code = code:gsub(p.pattern, function(var, value)
            return p.format:format(var, var, value)
        end)
    end
    code = ToPairsLoop(code)
    return code
end

funcs.base64.encode = function(data)

    end)..'0000'):gsub('%d%d%d?%d?%d?%d?', function(x)
        if (#x < 6) then return '' end
        local c=0
        for i=1,6 do c=c+(x:sub(i,i)=='1' and 2^(6-i) or 0) end
        return letters:sub(c+1,c+1)
    end)..({ '', '==', '=' })[#data%3+1])

        for i = 6, 1, -1 do

funcs.writefile = function(path, content)
 local Path = path:split('/')

 for i = 1, #Path do
  local a = Path[i]
  CurrentPath[i] = a
  if not files[a] and i ~= #Path then
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = {}
   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/') .. '/'] = files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')]

   files[table.concat(CurrentPath, '/')] = tostring(content)
  end
